description: This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit.

reviews.text:
Good:
Is the same property pictured, central area, includes washer/dryer combo, microwave etc
Bad: had to pay for hotel check in day, host didn’t bother to send check in details until after check in time. Also serious repairs needed to bathroom ceiling: completely rotten with zero ventilation, just a hole in wall where extraction fan used to be. Ceiling drips mouldy water on your head when you go to the toilet and mould spores released throughout room while sleeping causing respiratory issues. Even in the main living area I woke up to find water droplets all over my new MacBook Air. Mould can eventually pass blood/brain barrier causing neurological effects and is very dangerous. The mould spores collect in soft furnishings and host provided no vacuum cleaner, or way of cleaning those items, so mould, dust and dirt accumulates between guests without ever being cleaned. Unfortunately I didn’t thoroughly read reviews before booking or I would have known all of the above and not booked.

The placement is too close to the metro and metrobus stations and walk distance to Trump avm and Cevahir the big malls in the area. The consultant was so kind and helpful, the apartment clean and calme area. Thanks for this experience🫶
binaya giriş ve çıkışlar rahattı konum olarak idare eder oda genel olarak temizdi

Eğer 1-2 günlük konaklama için geleceksiniz sorun yok ama uzun süre kalınacak bir yer değil. 3 hafta kaldım sırf konumu için. 3 hafta boyunca yanı çarşaf ve yastık kılıflarını kullandım yedekleri yoktu bir kaç kez istememe rağmen vermediler süpürmek için süpürge yoktu onuda istememe rağmen tamam deyim vermediler. Banyo tavanı küflü ve havasız. Tuvalet banyo aynı yerde ve kullanışsız. Tuvalette ve duşta sıkıntı oldugunu belirtmeme ragmen kimse ilgilenmedi kendim yapmak zorunda kaldım. Daire kapıları bakımsız gecenin 3ünde yan dairenizin kapı sesi ile irkilerek uyanabilirsiniz tam kapanmıyor çünkü. O yüzden sert örtülüyor kapılar. Yer olarak tekstil atölyelerinin içinde oldugu için gün içinde çok gürültülü.
konaklamadan memnun kaldım. Konum olarak merkezi bir yerdeydi. Ev fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Ev sahibi alper bey mesajlara çok hızlı dönüş sağladı.

description:
Our apartment is within walking distance of all entertainment venues, touristic and historical buildings, shopping centers and is in a location where you can easily reach anywhere you want. It is possible to easily reach metro, bus, ferry and tram stations.

Taksim Square: 700 meters
Istiklal Avenue: 300 meters
Bus stops: 100 meters
metro station: 700 meters away
Note: Our apartment is located on the 2nd floor. (Elevator available)
Note: The minibar is extra charge.
Note: We collect ID information for system registration.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Orhan’s place. The location is excellent — close to Istiklal Street, restaurants, and easily accessible by taxis, buses, or trams. The room was comfortable and clean.
A small note: only European-style power sockets are available, so an adapter may be needed. A microwave would also be a great addition for future guests.
Overall, we were very happy with our stay. Orhan is a kind and responsive host — highly recommended!”

Öncelikle Orhan beye teşekkür ederim, kendisi gerçekten örnek bir ev sahibiydi. Araba parkı konusunda problem yaşadık ve kendisi elinden geldiğince bize yardımcı oldu, mesajlarımıza çok hızlı dönüş yaptı. Konakladığımız yer gerçekten tertemizdi ve 5 yıldızlı otel standartlarındaydı. Her şey fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Sadece araba ile ulaşım sağlayacaklar için park yeri sorunu var, cadde üzerinde ki yol kenarlarında yer bulabilirseniz oraya bırakabilirsiniz ya da eve 300-400m ücretli otoparklar var. Yürüyerek istiklal caddesine 7 dakikada gidebilirsiniz bu yüzden konum olarak iyiydi. Tek problem gece çok fazla araba gürültüsü oluyor. Ama onun dışında her şey güzeldi.

We had a very pleasant stay. The location was excellent, close to everything and very convenient. The room was clean, comfortable, and very well located.
Orhan was a great host, very attentive and always available. Whenever we contacted him, he responded very quickly and was always helpful.
We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place!

The best part of this stay was the host’s incredible responsiveness. As a host myself, I was impressed by how quickly he replied — less than 10 seconds no matter the time of day! The room itself was a typical hotel setup with all the necessary facilities, but I’m giving it 4 stars for a few reasons. The listing photos suggested there would be a mini fridge stocked with water and cold drinks, but that wasn’t the case. Luckily, we had a bottle of water with us when we checked in late at 1am. Also, the washroom had some waterlogging issues, with water not draining properly. Lastly, Netflix required a payment for access, which was unexpected.
Despite these minor things, I really enjoyed the stay and would happily book again, even if these items aren’t fixed!

prime location. very close to bus station and istiklal street.
room is clean and matches the photos. quiet at night if you keep the windows closed.
lots of mini markets, restaurants and cafés in the area.

description: Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this quiet and centrally located place. Located in the Fatih district, the center of Istanbul, tourist areas such as Sultanahmet Hagia Sophia, Beyazit Grand Bazaar, Eminonu Spice Bazaar are only 7-8 minutes away by tram. T1 Bağcılar-Kabataş Tram line is 4 minutes walking distance and M1 Yenikapı-Atatürk Airport Metro line is 10 minutes walking distance.

reviews.text:
The location was good.
Check in was easy.
But the property needs a serious revamp. Everything in the house is in a bad shape. Furniture is too old,bedding is too old and used.Washroom is too small and doors do not lock.There are lot of insects in the house and you get ants on the food within 10 minutes. Kitchen utensils are weired off and in a bad shape.The dustbin didn't have a liner inside.Internet only works in the living room and doesn't work in bedrooms. Television has to be replaced with a bigger one,it's an old and a very
small one.Cupboards doors are broken and do not slide.
Overall I would never recommend to stay here unless the owner renovate it.
Great location. Very polite host lady. Very peace full and safe surrounding, near to tram station. lots of car parks nearby. Clean flat, everything was there.

ev çok tatlıydı tam da fotoğraflarda olduğu gibiydi. kalabalık gelinecek bir ev. semt akşamları belli bir saatten sonra çok sessizdi, bunu bilerek gelinmeli ama bizim için sorun yaratmadı. yataklar, çarşaflar, banyo, tuvalet her yer gayet temizdi.

The place was noce and cozy, it was as shown in the pictures. The are was a very quiet area with a park infront of it and a close mode of transportation. But above all the host Hatice was really kind and welcoming us with a big smile and warm heart every single time.
All the appliances were very used and not clean. There were a lot of ants. The internet didn't work at all. The kitchen window kept opening, which was very scary.

description:
Comfortable Family Home in the Heart of the City, a Few Steps Away from Nişantaşı and the Metro!

By staying in this apartment located in one of Istanbul's most central and popular spots, you and your family can easily reach anywhere in the city.

Unique Location Advantages:


Comfortable and Accessible Family Home in the City Center!

By staying in this central apartment located right in the heart of the city, you and your family can easily reach anywhere.

reviews.text: As for the location, it is excellent and very close to the metro. As for the amount, I think it is a little exaggerated, especially since the apartment is very small and the bed is small for two people, but I think the price may be fair if we look at the location. In short, they treated us well and the location is beautiful, but the apartment was not as I expected. These are simple notes. Frankly, I give them 8 out of 10.

The location is excellent. And the building is quiet. The apartment is clean and very comfortable. The staff in the building are respectful and care about your comfort. I recommend it to people looking for privacy, tranquility ...

The check in process was good. There are lots of shops and eating places & transport all very close.
Apartment has dark blinds affixed to the windows so no natural light. It is very noisy, in general and the boiler is noisy.
During my stay there was a constant issue with the internet. I work using Zoom, not once did the internet work sufficiently. I had to buy additional data for my Turkish sim. The internet affected the TV which stopped working eventually.
They did attempt to fix the internet issue but it was a slow process.
The Host had an accident and was not present but his staff were.
5 days before I left, they moved me to a different apartment for the internet. I was told I had 15 mins to move. In the rush I forgot to grab my tea and coffee, which was thrown out.
While packing to leave I discovered a pair of new trainers I had bought were missing.
The Host could not seem to grasp what was missing on the Airbnb message app & as with the internet seemed uninterested.
konum çok iyi ve mekan temizdi

The place is very small but smartly designed and lovingly decorated.
There’s everything one needs and more. It’s very easy to walk around the area and lots of shops are nearby.
It’s a great place to get to know the area.

description: Welcome to our luxurious Istanbul flat! Just a 2-minute stroll from the vibrant Istiklal Street and a short 10-minute walk to two metro stations, our chic residence blends contemporary comfort with a prime location. A dedicated receptionist ensures your needs are met, and optional cleaning services add convenience. Immerse yourself in the city's energy, exploring effortlessly from our central haven. Book now for an unforgettable stay that combines style and convenience in the heart of Istanbul!

reviews.text:
The flat was very clean, it is like in the photos. Ida was a great host. She answers immediately and in a very polite and friendly way.
The bed is cozy and everything works.
Flat is near good places to visit and streets to walk, Istiklal is very close which makes it a central place.
Small markets around, places to eat as well.
I recommend it.

Ida is an amazingly sincere, open-minded, nice girl! She is really nice and friendly host. She was always in touch, it was a pleasure to communicate with her :)
The apartment was very clean, warm and cosy. The appartment has everything you need for a comfortable stay, as well as good WiFi and close to the centre.
I highly recommend it and hope to visit again :)

First of all, Mahdi and his team are excellent. They're responsive and they make sure that you have what you need as a tenant. The place is cozy, very nice, cleanand tidy, well decorated and perfect for one person or a couple. The location is right in the middle of everything you need in Istanbul. lots of amenities within a short distance. Excellent experience for Istanbul as a tourist and also business travel.
Thank you Mahdi and The team.

Generally, it was a nice stay, but not without its drawbacks.

description:
Our place just 4-5 minutes away from the Main Street of istiklal

Beyoğlu region and Galata was rebuilt after a big fire in 1870. We would define this date as the rebirth of Beyoğlu and say that many important historical buildings in Beyoğlu emerged after this date. The building was completed in 1872 by French architects in a European style. You will feel 150 years of history at Taksim, the foot of the Istiklal Street.
No elevator in the building. The apartment is on the 2nd floor.

reviews.text: We stayed here for a month and loved it. The apartment is in a renovated building with a lot of character, very clean and comfortable. There is plenty of light that can be blocked as needed. WiFi, AC, and shower worked great. Close to 2 grocery stores and a 5 minute walk to Istiklal St. The kitchen is well equipped, nice bathroom. The tram, Metro, and funicular are also a short walk away. We appreciated the two sets of towels and essentials at our arrival such as water bottles, soap and shampoo. Our host was very responsive and helpful. He helped us multiple times with finding tours, recommending places to visit, and arranging transportation to and from the airport. If we comeback to Istanbul we would definitely stay here.

The apartment was neat, and very comfortable. There was no unpleasant smell in the bathroom, the water pressure was excellent, and the internet connection was fast and reliable, which made it perfect for working remotely. The kitchen is well equipped, making the apartment suitable for long stays. The location worked very well for me. There are several supermarkets nearby, where I could even top up the Istanbulkart that the host kindly let me borrow. There is a short uphill walk to reach Istiklal Street, and I also found the bus convenient for getting to most places in the city. The host was incredibly kind, welcoming, and gave off a very positive vibe. He was thoughtful and generous throughout my stay. The only minor downside was some street noise, but simply closing the windows solved the issue. Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely stay here again.

We really enjoyed our stay at Melda-Kerem’s place. The apartment was clean, well-presented, and exactly as described. Melda-Kerem was very responsive and helpful whenever we had any questions, which made everything easy and stress-free. The street is quiet and we had no issues with noise. It’s also in a great location - close to public transport, but also walkable to many of the main sights if you don’t mind a bit of a stroll. We’d recommend staying here :)

I had an excellent overall experience. The unit is clean, modern, and thoughtfully designed, offering a comfortable and functional space that meets all essential needs. The furniture and amenities are well-maintained, and the check-in process was smooth and straightforward.
The location is strategic, with easy access to supermarkets, cafés, and main roads, which made the stay both convenient and efficient. The host was responsive, professional, and ensured all inquiries were addressed in a timely manner.
Overall, this apartment delivers strong value and a seamless guest experience. I would definitely consider staying here again and would confidently recommend it to others.

Amazing stay! The apartmentwas exactly as described—clean, cozy, and well-maintained. The host Ashraf was incredibly hospitable and provided great local tips. The location was perfect, with easy access to transportation . Highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Istanbul. Would definitely stay here again 🙏🙏❤️ Thank you Soooo much Ashraf🙏🙏

description: You will be able to reach your school and the central parts of the city very quickly while living in this location, which is 1 minute on foot to the subway and 3 minutes on foot to the tram. Since this apartment is on the historical peninsula, you will feel the spirit of Istanbul. Many markets, shopping malls (Historia Mall), restaurants and hospitals are within a 5-minute walk. The apartment consists of 3 rooms and you can stay alone in one room. This spacious and carefully decorated room will make you feel at home.

reviews.text:
What can I tell you, I had a great stay in Istanbul and in large part thanks to Atakan and his very charming house, he is a very responsive and welcoming host. The house is totally identical to the photos displayed, very clean, heated with all the amenities to spend a nice time so much that you feel at home, in terms of transport everything is nearby. A soothing calm reigns in the street where the house is located. The small shops nearby are absolutely kind (I made a lot of friends among them, my stay had become warm thanks to them) I highly recommend staying at Atakan and his magnificent house.
Thank you so much my friend ❤️ until I return to your beautiful city and house 😍

House was clean and fresh, had everything I needed (including hair dryer, lamp, washing machine, )
It was located on the top floor of 4-5 floor building, if it is uncomfortable for you to go by stairs bear this in mind
Hosts are good people and ready to assist you online.
Can’t say anything about the neighbourhood, stayed only for two days, and didn’t have any problems during my visit

I enjoyed my stay, the room and the flat was exactly as deccribed. Very cute and clean room that had everything needed, the neighborhood also felt safe and it was close to many restaurants and food markets, I think its very good especially for solo traveler. Mind the only detail - though the accommodation is located in Fatih neighborhood, this quarter is rather large so you will need time aprox. 30 minutes to access most known places such as Balat, Karaköy or Blue mosque etc (BUT the accommodation is good mid point between all these destinations due to close proximity of all travel means such as T1 tram, bus station or metro station).
Azerbaycandan bir kaç günlüyünü gittim Gerçekten çox anlayışlıydı ev sahibi.çok temiz odaları ve güzel ev dizaynı mövcut idi.ben çoook sevdim
Excellent location, clean and nice place, shared but still does feel very private, good amenities, overall surely one of the best airbnb stays in Istanbul

description:
Would you like a perfect stay at the heart of Istanbul's historic peninsula?

This booking offers a fully equipped luxury apartment on Bogazkesen, the Cultural Path connecting Galataport to the famous Istiklal Street. You will find historic monuments, galleries, antique stores, the best of local cuisine, vibrant nightlife and more just beside you.

With daily cleaning service, assistance for your concierge needs and dedicated parking space, this apartment is set to make your vacation memorable!

reviews.text: The apartment has potential, but my stay had many issues. The space needed deep cleaning after construction. Plaster dust in the shower, blocked kitchen sink, leaking bathroom sink. The windows weren’t soundproof. One didn’t even close. I couldn’t sleep due to loud street noise. In the morning it got worse with pupils gathering at the nearby Italian high school. The entrance door was kept open with a stopper, leaving the building unsecured at night. Large TV sets near the entrance posed a serious safety risk. The kitchen lacked ventilation, so cooking smells spread through the apartment. The TV didn’t work, and the fire and CO₂ detector was inactive. Some power sockets were loose, and turning lights on or off could cut all power, requiring a reset at the main switch. Despite all of this, the management were kind and responsive. I appreciated their help and communication. Once these issues are addressed, this place could be a very good stay.

I recently stayed in this lovely Airbnb in Galata, and it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. The room was spotlessly clean, comfortable, and beautifully designed — exactly as shown in the photos. The location is perfect, right in the heart of Galata, with easy access to cafes, restaurants, and public transportation.
Gulsah was incredibly kind, responsive, and genuinely attentive. They made sure everything was smooth throughout my stay and provided great local tips that made my time in Istanbul even more enjoyable. I truly felt welcomed and well taken care of.
I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul. I would definitely stay here again!

Birkac kez konakladigim bir yer, daireler her zaman cok temiz ve cok rahat oldugu icin bolgedeki konaklamalarimda tercih ediyorum, host ile iletisim mukemmel, her konuda cok kisa surede yardimci oluyor. Daireler genis ve isik aliyor, guvenli ve cok iyi tasarlanmis bir apartman, her anlamda bulundugu konumun en iyisi diyebilirim.
Great place to stay. very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The neighborhood is perfect for first time visitors to Istanbul with easy access to everything. Highly recommended!

Amazing place to stay - easy to get to Galata port and Taksim square. Lot's of amenities nearby. Apartments are exactly as shown on the photos. Host is friendly and responsive. I highly recommend this place to stay in :)

description:
This Luxury Apt (nicknamed the Aquarium for its big windows with panoramic views) is in a heritage building dating from 1850's which underwent a complete renovation & reinforcement project earning both a full earthquake fortification certificate as well as being referenced as a model example of a restoration.
It is centrally located on a lovely and quiet corner on Galata's most famous Serdar-i Ekrem St. with delicious & friendly cafes, artisanal life style shops, art galleries & antique shops.

reviews.text:
Absolutely lovely stay and even better host! My 3rd time in Istanbul, 2nd time staying in Galata area and Aaron was instrumental in ensuring we had a comfortable stay from start to finish. From assisting in reasonably priced private transportation to & from the airport, to helping us get rid of pesky flies. Aaron was a tremendous help, know you have that kind of support really makes a difference.
The space: Just as lovely as the photos, the view really is quite spectacular.
Heads up: the elevator is on the smaller side so if you have a bunch of luggage, you need to do multiple trips. Also, be mindful of the area. There are a few steep hills from the main road to the airbnb. Just prepare to walk up a bit. Besides that, the section of the street of this property is nice & quiet with a convenient market across the street that closes at 12:30am.
Overall, I highly recommend this spot and Aaron!

We had the pleasure of staying in Aaron’s upper apartment and what a view!! This place is as amazing as the photos! Aaron was the perfect host and was always available via text to answer any questions we had. Alaattin, who manages the apartments, greeted us at the door, helped us with our luggage and assisted us, always with a smile and a helping hand. This is the perfect location on a quiet cobblestone street but within close walking distance to the Galata Tower, Istiklal Street, Cihangir, and many other locations where you will find great restaurants, lively music, and local shopping. And you can easily take the metro or tram to other places in the city. The apartment has everything you need to help you feel like it’s your home away from home. The bed is comfortable, the kitchen is well-equipped, and there are many extras included. This was by far one of the best AirBnBs we have found. We will be back!

Couldn’t have picked a better location in the city. This place is 100/10 - even better than the photos! It’s extremely comfortable, clean, safe, well designed, much larger than we thought, and such a nice, calm and relaxing place to return to after the hustle and bustle of the city. Not to mention the views…outstanding! Million dollar view.
The location is perfect. You can walk to so many sites and restaurants and it’s close access to public transportation. The end of the street that it’s on is quiet compared to anywhere else.
Lastly, the owner Aaron is extremely kind, quick and efficient at communication and went above and beyond to help us resolve our luggage that was lost in Amsterdam. If we ever come back to Istanbul, we would not hesitate to stay here again. Perfect stay!

This is house is really the most iconic and beautiful house in this whole area. The view out to the water of the harbor is magnificent. This house was truly amazing in so many parts.
The panoramic window is huge, very eloquent thought out design, furniture. The entire house is huge looks just like the pictures, the bedroom is so well designed, the lighting is amazing, the bathtub, the bed was the most comfortable of our entire trip, kitchen was perfect.. Really this is a labor of love he made. Totally worth the price. And the location is the best!
This was our first trip to Istanbul and appreciated the list of things to do here sent us, places to eat, hammom experience. He went up and beyond his duty to help us and make us feel at home.

Aaron’s place did not disappoint! First class in every way. The view, the location, the functionality and attention to detail were flawless. The building manager was so accessible and helpful. Everything was exactly as pictured and described! A+++

description: It is a clean, comfortable and very useful house located in Sultanahmet Neighborhood, 10 minutes' walk from Hagia Sophia, Sultanahmet Mosque and Topkapı Palace, 3 minutes' walk from the sea, have a good holiday

reviews.text:
Our first accommodation was cancelled at the last minute and we were left with two tired kids and no where to stay. Diva host was very responsive and sent me directions to his restaurant nearby where we were met and taken to the apartment.
The entrance is in an alley and feels run down but the apartment itself was fine and as per the pictures. kitchen fridge wasn't that clean but the bathroom was new and clean and the bedrooms were nice with fresh bedding and towels.
Its located right next the the train line which was a concern but actually you hear no noise from it at all.
There are some restaurants and convenience stores right outside and it's only a few minutes walk to the water edge where you can catch the train. You can walk to the heart of Sultanahmet and Blue Mosque in minutes.
Overall it was good value for money and easily accommodated a family of 4, it has two bedrooms although the description says 1 bedroom.
Checkout was easy. . Overall good experience

The place was very clean as described, the bathroom was the most important part and it was new and clean. Apartment is on second floor, very nice area close to amazing restaurants, beach, the Blue Mosque, and train station. You have to try the surrounding restaurants such as Diva Restaurant and Fish Home. There is also a small family owned restaurant right next to it the apartment that served amazing breakfast and delicious Turkish coffee for a very affordable price comparing to the farthest restaurant. The entrance is a bit small with small stairs steps but thats how all houses in turkey are. Host is very responsive and helpful. Apartment maximum capacity is 5 people which was perfect for me, my husband, my two year old baby and my sister

The apartment was very clean, just as described. It’s a two-bedroom apartment on the second floor in a lovely area close to the beach, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Basilica Cistern, and the Metro station. You should definitely try the nearby restaurants, especially Diva Restaurant. The host was very responsive and helpful. Highly recommended!

Great place spend time near mosque and bazar. Host is nice and friendly. He invited us in restaurant as we arrived earlier than check in time. offered free snacks and tea. We carried extra luggage. Host helped to move stuff 2 stories up and brought 5 suite cases down at 3am, the day we left. We could not ask for more.
Couple of things to bear in mind, the flat is 2 stories above and narrow staircase can be risky especially if coming down ay night. middle light needs fixing so it's not dark in stair case. a small leak from hot water system needs fixing.
Washing machine, kitchen with pots etc, Instant fast pressure water in washroom, excellent bedrooms, air-conditioning are great in this flat.
Host should offer Washing liquid, soap, shampoo, 1 big bottle of water etc (may charge), its inconvenient to run for these things as soon you arrived there.
Overall a great place, close to all places in Sultanahmet
Many thanks Kanal , Muhammed and Co. You have been excellent!

Superb location, incredible host, clean and comfortable apartment with all utensils and kitchen appliances available. AC in the bedrooms, hair dryer, microwave, clothing iron, electric kettle, vacuum, laundry machine with detergent, towels, etc. Couldn't be happier, I would love to stay here again, I really recommend this accommodation!

description: Welcome to our cool new stylish 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home nestled in the vibrant heart of Şişhane. Perfectly situated for both business and leisure travelers, this modern abode offers comfort, convenience, and a taste of local Istanbul living! Comes with A/C, Wifi & Netflix!

reviews.text: Very spacious apartment with all the amenities you need and plenty of storage space. Responsive host. Great locations close to bars and restaurants and very close to metro station. However, it shows age and signs of wear and tear. The photos were taken while ago. Also the pillows were the cheapest synthetic so very uncomfortable. The only weird part from the host was that they asked us to empty the bin, which is unheard of especially when you pay cleaning fee.

I really, really highly recommend this place!
I’ve stayed here with my mum, sister and brother-in-law and we all agree that the place was great.
It’s very well located - a few minutes from the metro station and perfect for getting to various areas of Istanbul.
The host is very responsive and the instructions for self check-in were very clear.
The flat itself is better than expected. Very spacious, well decorated and has a charm. One bedroom comes with an en-suite shower/toilet. It’s spotlessly clean and had all the amenities/toiletries one needs.
Honestly, can’t fault it!
Check it out for yourself.
🌟🌟🌟

We booked right before we were supposed to arrive. Got to check in for free 2 hours before. Nice host who responded quickly, and was clear. The place was clean and nice. Got good slippers, and there was a bottle of water until we arrived. This was extra nice. The place is very central and close to both metro and taksim square. The only thing that was a bit stupid was that the internet didn't reach the bedrooms. All in all, we were happy. We will definitely come back.

Fantastic location 2 min walking to metro and 3 min to tram. 5 min walk to Galata tower and istiklal street. Communications with host was fluent and fast. Host always replied in less than 10 min. Checking into the apartment was very easy. Apartment itself is good and comfortable and everything work good but no WiFi in the bedrooms. Maybe missing a toaster. It’s a very good spot to spend some days in Instambul. Many good restaurants around. And good cafes for breakfast.

I was looking for a apartment to spend New Year with family in Istanbul. The apartment was perfectly matching with my needs. It has big, clean and well equipped kitchen, big dining table and big living room.
The apartment is well located close to Sishane metro station and Historical district of Galata tower. We had no problems going around the city using public transport.
There are few things which may be critical for future guests:
1) The apt is located on the 4th floor of the building in historical city center so there is no elevator and you need to use steps to reach it. We did not have a lot of luggage with us, so it was ok.
2) There is a mosque minaret close to apt, so be ready that few times a day you would hear call for pray.
3) The entrance to the house is located close to the road and you need to be careful and attentive going out or entering building.
In general we enjoyed staying in VNG property apt and I would recommend it to other travelers with no hesitation.

description:
You will have a very pleasant time in this cute small studio flat, which is in the most central point of Istanbul, in a quiet amazing historic location.

Our flat is 2nd floor, don't elevator and has small floor area.
Our flat has 1 double bed, 1 kitchen, 1 bath and a table, wifi, smart TV and air conditioning.
A 24-hour heating system and hot running water are available.

As a host with a high guest satisfaction rating, we’re always here to help ensure you have a wonderful stay in Istanbul..

reviews.text: Metin was a great host- super helpful at every step (including organising reasonably priced accomodation from and to the airport), and s always quick to respond. He helped me drag my suitcase up the stairs too! The apartment is great. It’s in an unbeatable location, has everything you need for a comfortable stay and was near and clean. My only minor gripe is slightly threadbare towels and limited kitchen tools- not really a problem when there are so many good food options in the city! I bought a knife and left it there for the next guests anyway 😊 Thank you Metin for helping to make my second time in Istanbul so enjoyable!

Metin’s place has easily made it on my top favorite airbnb’s list in Istanbul!
I loved the place and will definitely book again on my next visit❤️
Here’s my detailed feedback,
1- self-check in was helpful since i arrived at 1 am.
2- room is spacious, clean and comfortable.
3- bathroom is small but comfortable, hot & strong water pressure in the shower
4- amenities like disposable slippers available, extra towels, extra toilet paper, 2 bottles of water in fridge
5- Heating was on at all times, when i checked in the room was already warm, and the AC works well.
6-location is in a dead end street which means so quite at night but also few steps away from supermarkets, local boutiques, galata tower, restaurants and coffee shops.
7- public transportation is few min away and also the street is accessible with taxis.
8- I felt safe because main door has pin code access that changes daily+ security camera (good for solo travelers)
9- Host was super responsive, helpful and very kind

Mixed review about the stay.
Positive- Metin is lovely and communication was fantastic. Responded quickly. It was self check in and instructions were clear to follow. Ideal location with it being 5 minutes from Galata tower and 10 min uphill walk to istikal street. As well as being fairly close to the main attractions
Unfortunately, the state of the bathroom let the whole stay down. It wasn’t cleaned properly and the photo is definitely an old one. There’s no ventilation in the shower so a constant damp smell. The bedding and pillows could also do with an upgrade. Absolutely nothing to the pillows and really rough bedding. Didn’t sleep well even though the mattress was comfy.

This unit is in a great spot, walking distance to Istiklal street where all the restaurants and shopping centers are.
The apartment is clean and matches the photos. No complaints at all.
Metin is a great host and very responsive and friendly, he even booked a Taxi for me to airport and the price was good.
Unfortunately my flight got rescheduled and I only spent a day at this location, I love to go back next time I am in Istanbul.

Apartment is amazing - perfectly located to most attractions, room is clean and comfortable, the host was super helpful with clear directions and also in arranging a taxi for the airport. Numerous restaurants within short walking distance. One topic which the host should mention is that the property does not have an elevator, we were booked on the second floor and wife was just recovering with a leg muscle sprain. Else everything was fantastic and we would love to go back again

description:
The Row Hotel is welcoming guests to enjoy its warm and friendly charm in the heart of the Istanbul Taksim.
Everything chosen for an excellent night's sleep and pleasing daytime moments. All our suites offer comfort simplicity and a lack of fuss, upholding the highest of hygiene standards and attention to detail throughout. The warmest welcome awaits.

reviews.text:
I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb in Istanbul! The location couldn’t be better—just a few minutes’ walk to Taksim Square. The building’s lobby was spotless and always had a pleasant scent. The host was incredibly welcoming—quick to respond to messages and always proactive in providing useful information. They helped us with everything from currency exchange tips to recommending affordable taxis and great restaurants.
The apartment itself matched the photos exactly—clean and well-maintained. While the kitchen setup was simple—ideal for a trip where you don’t plan on extensive cooking—it had all the essentials: plates, utensils, and basics. I’m sure if you need anything else, the host would provide it.
The only minor note is that since it’s in a busy tourist area, you might hear some street noise at night—but that’s part of the central location charm! If you’re sensitive to noise, just bring earplugs. Overall, I couldn’t recommend this host and apartment enough—definitely a 5-star

Our stay at the hotel was truly wonderful. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and modern. The location is very convenient, with shops and everything you need nearby. The staff were friendly and always ready to help. Great value for the price! I would definitely recommend this place and would love to stay here again on my next visit.

Our stay was absolutely fantastic! It was even beyond our expectations. There were two Smart TVs in our place and the wifi was even faster than the one I have at home. During our stay, we really didn't want to leave our suite :) The most comfortable beds, nice shower, fully equipped kitchen, excellent staff and best location of course! Everything was brand new and super clean. Thank you The Row team for making us feel like home. I am definitely recommending this place to everyone!
Best Location near Taksim , all Staff are extremely helpful emre and zeyad were heplful through out our stay the space was very clean and well maintained
We were here for the European cup final and location and hotel were excellent. Said on reception was very helpful and we would highly recommend.

description:
Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located quiet place. The apartment is a 2-storey duplex. It is decorated in accordance with the historical texture of the neighborhood. You can walk to the 24-hour vibrant life center and the subway in 10 minutes. Its location is very quiet.
We guarantee that you will be satisfied with the comfort of our beds for a comfortable sleep. You can sit in front of the terrace or upstairs window and sip your coffee with a beautiful view of Istanbul.

reviews.text: My stay at Kemal’s place was wonderful. The apartment was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and very well located. Kemal was a thoughtful and responsive host, making sure everything was smooth from check-in to check-out. I especially appreciated the small touches that made the space feel welcoming. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting the area.

This place is incredibly cozy, private, and full of charm. Located on a hilltop with a stunning view from the balcony and the second-floor attic bedroom, it's perfect for relaxing, exploring Istanbul, and recharging. Kemal is a friendly and responsive host.
Pros: The tiny but exceptionally cozy bedroom is ideal for romantic or solo stays—it feels straight out of a "lo-fi beats" video cover. All necessary amenities (washing machine, heater, AC, kitchen, Wi-Fi, two TVs) work flawlessly. The Wi-Fi speed (25 Mbps) is good enough for video calls and basic work. Nice cafés, groceries, and ferry/bus stops are all within a 10- 15-minute walk. I'll book it again for sure.
Things to consider: The apartment is uphill, so it might be challenging for elderly guests, children, or people with mobility limitations—but the amazing view makes the climb worth it, and you get used to it. Construction work is also happening not that far away, but all the noise ends within an hour, and it's not permanent.

Absolutely loved my stay at Kemal's apartment. The apartment really felt like a home which is what I wanted. Kemal is a very kind and responsive host. I liked that the mezzanine with the double bed was up stairs and the bottom door could be shut for privacy. The other room with two double beds was downstairs (by the kitchen) also had its own door. There was also a balcony with a gorgeous view of the city. Except for the first day when there was construction, the apartment is super quiet and I slept so amazingly (as someone who is noise sensitive) so would recommend the location. There are many stairs to get up to the property and it's on a hill - I personally didn't mind but just to note. Overall would really recommend staying in Kemal's home, will miss it !

The location is amazing, set near the main points of Istanbul and within 10 minutes away from any bus. And the apartment is great too and the view was amazing. Kemal was a great host too, he helped us to find the best affordable foods and how to avoid tourists trap. And the apartment is cozy, and very clean and beautiful with free shampoo and body wash and cooking oil and coffee etc . However, it is quite cramped and small, so if you have lots of luggage it might feel cramped in there. The upstairs section was spacious but the ceiling is low, if you are a average height person 175cm+, it might be a little difficult as you might head your head multiple times. The other disadvantage is that despite being close and the location amazing, the walk there is very tiring, it is a uphill incline walk combined with the apartment on the 5th floor makes it a tedious challenge as there is no lift and 5 floors up making carrying luggages challenging and everytime you come back, you have to walk up.

reviews.text:
This apartment is literally next door to Galata Tower. Great restaurants and shopping in the neighborhood . The views from the rooftop terrace were breathtaking. Couldn't have asked for a better location . Be aware that the neighborhood is on a hill in a walking district. Getting in and out requires walking up and down stairs or streets. The apartment itself is a up a few flights of stairs. No elevator. The area and apartment are worth it though and it will help you work off all the calories from the great food in the area.
Mico was responsive and communicative. They even helped to arrange airport transfers. An associate met me at the property and helped orient me to the apartment and the neighborhood.

Everything was perfect! I saw a comment that they can help with transport from and to the airport and it’s definitely worth it! As they know exactly when you arrive and help with departure, also they take out the guessing part on how or what service to use, to get to the apartment. Very centrally located extremely close to the tower and the terrace has an excellent view specially at night when all the buildings light up. There are always stores nearby open almost 24 hours and places to eat nearby. A lot of taxis drop off people at the tower so it makes it very easy to grab a taxi daily leaving the apartment. Thanks a lot ! The hosts were extremely accommodating, I would give them a 6th star because of that!!!

Ev konumu ve giriş olanakları açısından bir sorun yaşamamamıza rağmen, maalesef temizlik konusunda kalınabilecek seviyede değildi. 2 gecelik rezervasyonumuz olmasına rağmen ilk gece konakladıktan sonra çıkmak zorunda kaldık ve başka bir yere ödeme yapmak zorunda kaldık. Bizimle iletişime geçen beyefendiye erken çıkış yaptığımı söylediğimde sebebini sordu, ben de “evin kalınamayacak kadar pis olduğunu” belirttim. Ancak bundan sonra tarafımıza herhangi bir geri dönüş yapılmadı.
Evin girişinde misafirler için bırakılan plastik hamam terlikleri ve pembe pelüş terlikleri gördüğümüzde ise adeta şok olduk. Böyle bir şeyin olması kesinlikle kabul edilebilir değildir.
Özellikle WC ve duş kısmının acilen yenilenmesi gerekiyor; ne sıcak su düzgün akıyor ne de yeterince temizdi.
Her şeyi tolere edebilirim ama temiz olmayan bir ortamda kalmak gerçekten çok kötü bir deneyimdi.
Kusura bakmayın.

Great location! The apartment was as described and looked like the photos. Not quite as new as expected, but it didn’t bother us. Meso was very responsive and were able to store our luggage in the apartment after checking out. We enjoyed our time in Istanbul and at Mesos place.

We had the most wonderful stay from beginning to end. The apartment was clean and wonderfully located, with the most beautiful rooftop terrace. The bedrooms were spacious and beautifully designed, as were the kitchen and the living and dining area.
I would 100% recommend this apartment and would love to come back as soon as possible.
Thank you very much for an amazing stay, and hopefully see you soon! ✨

description: In the heart of the district, please be ready to explore Kadıköy very easily with attractions nearby our hotel and enjoy about your sightseeing. Hotel is located 1 minute to ferry, 2 minutes to bazaar and 5 minutes away from the bull statue, which is considered the center of Kadıköy.

reviews.text:
Sorunlar:
1) En büyük sorun odanın fotoğrafta gözüktüğünden kat kat küçük olması. Hareket etmek çok rahat değildi ve içindeki yatak odanın çoğunu kaplıyordu.
2) Yan odaların sesleri bizim odamıza geliyordu o yüzden mahremiyet konusunda biraz sıkıntı vardı.
3) Banyosu, özellikle duş çok küçüktü, rahat hareket edilmiyordu ve duş başlığının asılı olduğu aparat bozuk olduğu için zor duş alınıyordu. Ayrıca kabin de sıkıntılıydı su kabinin dışarısına çıkıyordu. Tehlikeli
4) Balkon da aynı şekilde çok küçüktü. Sadece 1 kişi kullanabiliyordu.

İyi yönleri:
1) En iyi yönü gerçekten temiz olması ve bunun hissedilebilmesiydi. Normalde yatak temizliği konusunda çok titizimdir ve kolay kolay rahat edemem ama gerçekten yastıklar da çarşaflar da temizdi ve temiz kokuyorlardı. Havlular da aynı şekilde temizdi.
2) Oda her ne kadar küçük olsa da dekorasyon açısından iyiydi ve içinde bulunmak keyifli hissettirdi.
3) Konumu gerçekten çok merkezi bir yer. İstediğiniz her yere kolaylıkla ulaşabilirsiniz.

Oda genel olarak fotoğraftaki gibiydi ama çok küçüktü biraz daha büyük olsaydı süper olurdu. Onun haricinde temizdi ve konum olarak çok iyiydi sadece konumdan kaynaklı gece fazla gürültü oluyor ama o da normal çünkü Kadıköy’ün göbeğinde konaklıyorsunuz. Kısa süreli konaklama için fiyat performans diyebilirim.

İlk kiralama deneyimimde tercih edebileceğim en iyi yer olabilir. Aşırı temiz olduğuna dair yorumlardan dolayı tutmuştum ve cidden aşırı temizdi. Her yere olan ulaşım çok kolay olduğu için konumu benim için çok kullanışlıydı. Çok ilgililerdi ve hep iletişimdeydiler. Kesinlikle tercih edebileceğiniz bir yer.
İnanılmaz temizdi, yatak yastiklar her şey çok rahattı, çalışanlar çok tatlıydı. Kesinlikle tekrar geldiğimde sizi tercih edeceğim
Konumu oldukça iyi, temiz ve göründüğü gibiydi. Biz çok memnun kaldık

description: This perfect Istanbul home in the heart of Cihangir offers the chance to experience the city like a local while enjoying modern luxuries. Set in a brand new building, the unit features 1 Bedroom, 1 Bath, a Living Room (w/ sofa bed), a fully equipped Kitchen, and access to a shared Terrace with stunning Bosphorus and Golden Horn views. Thoughtfully decorated with modern furnishings and amenities, this stylish, centrally-located home lets you enjoy Istanbul’s best in comfort and style.

reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment is clean, cozy, and fully matches the description and photos. It was very comfortable to sleep there, the air conditioning worked well, and there was almost no street noise. Overall, we had a very pleasant stay and would happily recommend the apartment.
A couple of things future guests may want to keep in mind: the neighborhood is very hilly, so almost every route involves either going uphill or downhill. If you are arriving with large suitcases, I would especially recommend taking a taxi directly to the apartment, as Google Maps may route you from public transport through a very long staircase, which can be quite difficult with luggage.
The water pressure is also a little weak, but this seems to be fairly common in older buildings in Istanbul. Other than that, everything was great.

I had previously stayed in another apartment managed by this host and was happy to return. This apartment was just as wonderful - a quiet bedroom with a very comfortable bed, a well-equipped kitchen (truly, it has everything you might need), and a perfect location.
What I particularly appreciate about this host’s apartments is their impeccable cleanliness—you can tell great care and attention go into maintaining them.
The location is ideal. If you’re arriving from Taksim Square with luggage, you can easily walk, as the route is relatively flat (not always the case with Cihangir).
Highly recommended!

Truly a delightful stay in Istanbul. We needed a place that was close to Galataport for our upcoming cruise and this fit the bill. Don’t expect to be able to make it down to the port with lots of heavy luggage but nothing a quick $5 uber ride can’t fix. Otherwise the flat was super convenient by local transportation provided you are dropped off in the Taksim area (you have to trudge up tons of stairs for the T1 stops). The rooms are clean, comfortable, and an excellent value for the price. All the necessities are there and there’s a decent rooftop you can access. There are fantastic restaurants and many cute cats in the area. I had a great stay here and would recommend it wholeheartedly if you can manage walking up and down stairs every day.

I had a great stay in this apartment! It was clean, looked like the photos, and had all the amenities I needed. The host is responsive, and the staff member who gave me a tour of the apartment was helpful.
The location is fantastic, with great cafes and restaurants around the corner and many other neighborhoods within walking distance. I felt safe walking home late at night.
I would stay here again!

Perfectly located in a great neighborhood with a market just around the corner, coffee houses less than a block, very cool neighborhood. Place was even better than described and the host was proactive in communicating. This was a really great space and we felt like locals. The upstairs balcony/ terrace is great to take in an evening or morning with probably one of the better views we had of the city.

description: Located in the center of the city, our hotel offers an ideal accommodation experience for families and couples with its modern studio rooms. With its spacious and comfortable rooms, it will be as comfortable as your home, and thanks to the central location of our hotel, popular restaurants, shopping spots and cultural riches are just a few steps away. We are waiting for you to have a pleasant stay with your family or loved ones and to have the opportunity to relax while exploring the city life.

reviews.text:
This is completely worth the money! Extremely affordable, and very close to centre. The hotel itself was very safe, with a keypad lock, elevator, cameras, and double locks on the room doors. The place was decently maintained. Its located at a bit of a downward slope, but there is a better route to take from the next street.
The host is very helpful and kind, and was always available for any assistance. They also had daily cleaning, and provided everything they possibly could.
Overall cleanliness wise you get what you pay for, and the area can get just a bit dodgy at night but there are cabs available for very cheap + people in the area generally minded their own business.
All things considered a brilliant place and host, and I would stay here again.

Overall the value to stay in the location was definitely worth it although there could be improvements. Being so near Taksim was a major bonus as well as many shops and restaurants were nearby. The beds were comfortable and the general area was quiet.
One issue we faced was the hot water didn’t work well enough for the first few days and sometimes it didn’t work at all. Showering was difficult. They didn’t provide enough ammenities as there was no shower gel just shampoo. Only one roll of toilet paper was provided also. We stayed for 4 days and had to use the same towels over and over again. These were some let downs from the stay.

The place looks exactly like the photos. It was the perfect location for us , we were in Istanbul for one night and it was just about what we needed. Taksim square, a major hub, was within walking distance, transportation, restaurants and shops were conveniently within 10 min walk. We would recommend it. The host was so kind and helpful with helpful tips and suggestions for places to visit and eat out.

pros:
- lovely, responsive, helpful host
- included all basic amenities mentioned in listing
- clean
cons:
- located in a dodgy part of Taksim and located on a steep road - we were scared when coming back at night, this was our main let down
- very slow wifi that would also keep disconnecting
- shower was very small and low pressure shower head - hard to wash with

Generally good. The host was super friendly and attentive. The area is only 2 streets away from the Taksim Square, but feels rather unsafe during the night. Also, it was a bit hard to find since there are no clear signs of the hotel on the street. The room was a bit smaller than in the picture, but that was not a problem. It was a bit dirty for Turkish standards, but we only stayed for 1night, so it wasn't a big deal.

description:
Wonderful 4 room apartment 140 m2
3 bedrooms so one with shower and private toilet, balcony overlooking the sea.
It is on the 4th floor with elevator, with air conditioning in the living room and in the master bedroom, fully equipped... FREE Wi-Fi + FREE Parking
I speak, I speak 🇫🇷🇬🇧🇹🇷.

reviews.text:
It was a very clean and nice apartment designed and decorated very good. The apartment has a great living room with a nice balcony with beach views. Has a clean kitchen with new and fresh dishes. Bedrooms are very comfortable and nice. A best place for family trip in a quiet location for walking around and relaxing.
I, my wife and our kids really enjoyed our one week in Istanbul staying at this apartment.

Alex is an outstanding host. He is respectful, responsive, professional, and genuinely cares about his guests' experience. Communication was excellent throughout our stay, and whenever an issue arose, he responded promptly and did everything he could to help.
The apartment offers a great location, beautiful views, and a peaceful atmosphere. During our stay, we unfortunately experienced a few technical issues, mainly with the elevator, the air conditioning, and a few maintenance items. I genuinely believe we were simply unlucky to experience them. I would also recommend checking the balcony railing, which felt loose during our stay, especially for families with young children. I reported this to Alex, and he assured me it would be addressed.
Despite these inconveniences, we genuinely enjoyed our stay. Alex's professionalism, honesty, and supportive attitude made a real difference, and I would happily stay here again and confidently recommend him as a host.

Excellent apartment, highly recommend!We absolutely loved our stay! The apartment is spacious, bright, and very clean. We found it with no trouble at all; the location is perfect. The neighborhood itself is very quiet and neat, yet everything you need is close by.The absolute highlight of this apartment is the huge terrace with a stunning sea view. Spending time there was pure pleasure!Special thanks to the host for his hospitality. He stayed in touch constantly, guided us through every step of our check-in and stay, and replied to all messages instantly.We will definitely come back here again!

The apartment was quiet, spacious and clean with a great view of the sea. Alex was a super easy host - always answered right away. We were visiting family near by - for us it was a perfect location for this trip.

konaklamam gayet güzel ve iyi geçti kendimi evimde gibi hissettim evin konumu temizliği eşyaların temiz ve yeni olması her şey çok iyi ve güzeldi ev sahibine teşekkür ediyorum ve herkese tavsiye ediyorum

description: This suite has a private kitchenette and a private bathroom with jacuzzi. There is 24 hours door man and there is cleaning service once every 2 days. The complex has private Turkish bath, sauna and fitness room. The turkish bath and sauna is private and need to be booked upon arrival for free entrance. There is a shared sea view roof terrace.

reviews.text: Stayed here for a few nights for my first time exploring Istanbul. The Apartment and hosts are very welcoming and kind. Looks exactly like the pictures and the AC worked great which was a plus during the heat wave. The only bad part was unfortunately there was some construction going on which made it a bit difficult to access the side walk in front of the hotel especially since it’s on a steep hill as well. If you plan on traveling with larger luggages be prepared to have to walk up stairs and hills to get here since many of the taxis won’t drive up due to the traffic. Otherwise it’s a great location as you’re close to many main attractions and public transportation.

Good location. Quite street. All touristic attractions are prox 5-10 minute walk. Very accessible to public transport like tramway.
The host provides airport pick and drop if requested.
All the hosts are very fluent in English and have the best tips in store for their guests.
Erol is the best :D !!!
Everyone is friendly;always smiling.
They have a terrace with an amazing sea view. You can take your snacks or drinks and enjoy the weather.
They have their own hamam in the building,which we were much enjoyed.
Although there are many public Hamams nearby.
There is a small gym in the basement (which you probably won’t need because of the steep streets you have to climb up and down)
Cleaning was done everyday, towels replaced.
Always offering tea/coffee and biscuits in the lobby.
Lobby and rooms alike are very stylish.
There is a small tuck shop adjacent. Where you can buy almost anything. Bigger supermarkets like show and shock are 3 minutes walk.
We also found a lamp shop in the same street who had better price than you will find in Grand Bazaar and it’s surroundings.
Many cafes and restaurants opened till 1-2am.
Overall the place is very safe. There is always someone at the reception no matter if it is early morning or late night.
We enjoyed evening and night walks. Mosques look better at night with all the pretty lighting.
Because of the hosts and the amazing location of the suites we had an amazing and pleasant stay, no different than home.
Stayed here for 15days and we already miss everything.
Hope to come again in future.

This air bnb is located in a location that we appreciated. We were walking distance to the train station, and lots of local shops.
The air bnb blocks out street noise. It was clean, comfy and a really good nights sleep.
The team were so helpful, we landed/ arrived so late at night and we were welcomed so nicely. We were up three flights of stairs and we got help with baggage up the stairs.
Would stay here again :)
The staff are so so friendly! Thank you guys!
It’s very much like a hotel but with a more personal touch.

Easy to find and nice that it has an elevator.
We arrived at 1am and were greeted quickly, couple of issues:
-our room did not match the pictures, we were told they changed our room to another building as the other building did not have an elevator, I understand but this should of been communicated prior.
-the AC was impossible to control and thus it was always boiling in the room, seems to be older and the remote was iffy.
-water was walking from our bathroom sink - they fixed it the next day but it was not pleasant.
Some pros:
- clean overall
- lots of great restaurants nearby
- hospitality is great
- the upstairs terrace is very nice.

We enjoyed our stay in this clean apartment but is within walking distance of many of Istanbul’s tourist attractions. Our host helped us with restaurant recommendations and an orientation of the city with a map. The room was clean and comfortable with minimal street noise at night. The stairs up to the unit are quite steep and would not be appropriate for someone with mobility issues. We also appreciated our host calling a taxi for us on the morning of our departure

description: Welcome to a local Istanbul experience in the heart of Kadıköy! Our charming building is over 110 years old and is situated right by the seaside, offering stunning views from the common terrace which is a perfect spot to enjoy the sights and sounds of the city. After 10 pm, the common terrace is all yours to relax and unwind! Kadıköy is known for its social & cultural activities, making it one of Istanbul's most vibrant districts. You'll find all means of transportation within walking distance.

reviews.text: The flat is okey. Good location, polite host and not high price. But there was a problem with wi-fi (the host wrote 24mb but in fact it was under 10mb) Also I don’t like that water in the shower was warm only ~15 minutes (because of boiler). And I saw a lot of dust on the shelves. We were in March and sometimes it was a little cold because there were just two electric heaters.

Pros:
Location location location. Really easy to get around in Istanbul, since it’s close to the ferry terminal, metros, busses and tram. Also I love Kadiköy so this was a perfect spot.
Cosy studio, with nice wooden floors. Okay bed and nice pillows.
Good communication with the host.
Cons:
The terrace actually, people spent a lot of time there smoking, so I needed to have the curtains closed for them to not see me walking around inside.
Water in bathroom was a bit weak, and either too hot or cold, but this is usually the case in Airbnbs in Istanbul.
No elevator.
No table for eating inside, but I didn’t cook, since there’s plenty of good restaurants nearby
Overall, okay place to stay for a shorter time!

The location is good. The place was clean.
But the shower is not working at all, it is impossible to take a shower at the place, which I think for this price it should be pretty simple thing to fix. For the same price you could get better place around the same area. Also couldn’t get the heater working. AC didn’t work either.
!!before you book check with host of these things are fixed, if not it is not worth it.

The Apt is pretty much as described. It's clean, cosy, you can have a nice time during your stay in Kadiköy, it's very well located, the communication with Demir is excellent, check-in and out works very well even without meeting someone. So actually it should be a 5* ranking. Here come the 'but':
You share the terrace with your neighbours. Those people are sitting literally with you in your living- and bedroom. There is no privacy going to the bathroom or even going to bed.
It has been said that there is a closing hour of the terrace at 9pm during the week and 10:30pm on the weekend. I had to kick off people from the terrace every night at 11pm or later. Every night ! Thats quite annoying especially when they start to argue with you. Demir posted the Terraces rules (closing hours) at the door, but without attention to anyone. There should be a careholder who is responsible to lock the door. That did not work at all. Nevertheless I even found a paper in the hallway with closing hours of the terrace announced later than midnight every day... so I don't know what to say.
Demir is trying his best to run the apt smoothly for his guests, but that terrace issue should really be solved accordingly. That's why I did a 3* ranking only.

There was a heavy storm started the day we've first arrived, and it pretty much continued for the rest of our stay. That's why, the terrace wasn't very useful for us, nonetheless it was very peaceful and enjoyable while we used it.
Unfortunately we had a problem with the terrace door due to the very strong wind, however Demir was helpful with the communication.
In general, the location and the interior of the apartment are great. There could be some improvements done in the shower, although overall it's fine for a short stay.
I appreciate the kind and helpful communication by the host, as well as their hospitality. I'd recommend this stay!

description:
This special place is close to everything, only 5 minutes to Taksim and makes it easy to plan your trip. It is in a perfect location for transportation. The apartment is in the newest and most prestigious residence of this area. Free indoor and outdoor parking, free pool, sauna, gym and 24/7 professional security service.
All the items in my apartment have been carefully prepared for you, the apartment is perfectly prepared before you arrive for you to have an unforgettable stay here, it is a very clean and unique apartment.

reviews.text:
2 stars — Disappointing stay
Unfortunately, my parents’ stay was disappointing. The apartment is next to a busy road, so road noise is significant, especially at night, and there is very little within comfortable walking distance or nearby to do. The convenience store downstairs is useful, but extremely expensive.
A lot of basic kitchenware was missing, including essential cookware and utensils. There was also no room-cleaning service, despite this being a longer stay, and breakfast was not provided even though it was described as an included service.
The staff were polite, but the overall management and preparation of the unit need significant improvement. The property has potential, but the experience did not match what was advertised.

Burak is a grate host.
Always helpful easy to stay in touch.
He was polite and helped with everything we needed!
The accommodation was amazing. Super clean eveything was amazing!
With booking you get free access to the Pool, sauna, hamam (steam room) and also the gym with no additional price of accommodation.
Near the hotel there is a lot of little shops that are affordable!
you can order food in your room from the restaurants downstairs!
We would highly recommend and will definitely come back one day if we go Istanbul again. Everything was ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Burak is a really nice and friendly host. The Airbnb looks just like in the photos — clean and comfortable. It's about a 15-minute walk from Taksim's main street, so the location is quite convenient. Recommended!

One word: FANTASTIC! From the moment we landed at Istanbul Airport, our experience with Brooks Transfer and Burak was incredible. Our VIP driver was kind and funny, and Burak greeted us warmly at the building, even offering us drinks while we waited for the apartment. The apartment itself was spotless, spacious, and fully furnished with a great smell, fast Wi-Fi, and a big TV. Burak checked in to make sure everything was perfect—and it truly was. The bedsheets were clean, the balcony view was amazing, and he helped us with everything until the very end. He didn’t even ask for the transfer payment until I brought it up. Burak is not just the best host I’ve met—he’s one of the kindest people I’ve ever come across. It felt like I’d known him for years. I’ll recommend him to everyone visiting Istanbul. Thank you, Burak!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely Amazing Stay – Felt Like Home!
I stayed at Burak’s Airbnb in Istanbul for two weeks and I can honestly say it was one of the best experiences I’ve ever had. The apartment was large, spacious, and incredibly clean. Anything I needed or was missing, Burak made sure it was replaced immediately – his attention to detail and hospitality were unmatched.
The place had a beautiful balcony, and the overall atmosphere felt very homely and welcoming. One of the biggest conveniences was that his father ran a supermarket right on the ground floor, which made grocery shopping so easy and accessible.
The neighborhood itself was safe and full of friendly locals, which made the entire stay even more enjoyable. On my final night, Burak generously upgraded me to a stunning duplex apartment on the top floor – free of charge. It was a kind and unexpected gesture that really meant a lot.
By the end of my stay, Burak didn’t just feel like a host – he became a friend.

description:
Stylish 4BR Duplex in Cihangir – Walk to everywhere

Stay in a beautifully designed 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom ground-floor duplex in trendy Cihangir, Istanbul. Steps from cafes, shops, and restaurants. Walk to Taksim Square, Istiklal, Galata Tower, and Galataport. Easy tram access to Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque & Topkapi. Perfect for families & groups in a safe, central neighborhood!

reviews.text:
We stayed in two properties in the area, and the neighborhood is simply unbeatable if you are visiting Istanbul. It’s close to public transportation and all the major tourist sites. The vibe is very eclectic, with plenty of restaurants, cafés, art boutiques, and antique shops—full of character and charm.
The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos: beautifully decorated, very clean, and with comfortable beds. The décor perfectly reflects the atmosphere of the neighborhood and the spirit of old Istanbul.
The host was amazing. On our last night, we had an issue with another property and had to move out. He kindly welcomed us very late at night, took the time to explain everything, and even allowed us a late check-out.
We truly appreciated the hospitality and would definitely stay here again.

We had a wonderful time staying here, the apartment was just as described; well decorated and clean & in a perfect location. It was a great base for exploring Istanbul and near a number of local amenities.
Host was very accommodating, check-in was flexible and easy, and they kept in contact to ensure all was well and even gave some great recommendations for places to visit and eat. I would definitely recommend.

The place is as pictured. The host is attentive and helpful. The neighbourhood is very nice (but expensive!)
Only thing is the sheets are quite scratchy and beds not so comfortable (other than the master bedroom, which was soft and comfortable)
I would recommend to stay here :)

From before we arrived and during the stay communication was amazing. Check in was very simple and Elif gave us great tips on near by food spots. The apartment was very clean and super comfortable for our group. The location was amazing and close to so many great places but also walkable to the tram and metro.
I would highly recommend for anyone to stay there. And if I’m in Istanbul again I will check to see if apartment is available.

Incredible place! There were four of us and we each had our own room with large, comfortable beds. The shower pressure and temperature was great.
Elif was extremely helpful and communicative throughout our stay, checking in periodically to make sure everything was okay and responding quickly whenever we had a question.
The apartment is located in Cihangir which is my favorite area of Istanbul. It's walkable, lively, and full of great cafés, but still relaxed at night.
Would absolutely stay here again!

description:
Our centrally located apartment is on the street where the ŞİŞLİ CEVAHİR Shopping Center is located in the center of Istanbul.
CEVAHİR Shopping mall is only 50 meters from our home.
Metro, Metrobus and Bus stops are 2 minutes away on foot.
It is located in the center of the city, where transportation to all parts of Istanbul will be easily provided. Taksim Istiklal Avenue and Beşiktaş Square are 5 minutes away by public transportation.
Our house is a quiet and safe apartment in a newly built building.

reviews.text: The location is great, in front of the mall and convenient with supermarkets, restaurants, and subway. Emre is easy to interact with; the check-in was easy. Elevator in the building was a convenience, especially with our luggage. But my overall experience was negative. Upon entering, I noticed an unpleasant odor coming from the bathroom, which seemed to be emanating from the drains. Cleanliness was lacking, with fingerprints visible on the mirrors and TV screen. The weather was inconsistent during our stay, with cold nights and hot afternoons. The listing mentioned both heating and cooling amenities, but it only had a proper heating system and lacked adequate cooling. Another downside was the excessive noise from the neighboring unit. The walls are thin providing no sound isolation, and the shared patio amplified the disturbances. The neighbors kept the window open and conversed loudly, during the night. I had to ask them to keep the noise down. So, I decided to cut my stay short.

We were very happy with our stay and would definitely return. The apartment was clean, the bathroom and sheets spotless, and the master bed very comfortable (twin beds are fine but short for guests over 6 ft). The host was responsive and easy to communicate with.
The location is excellent—safe, lively, and directly across from a mall entrance with access to the Şişli Metro and buses. Grocery stores and a hospital are nearby. The kitchen has a dishwasher, washing machine (no dryer, but clothes dry on the rack in a day), pots, pans, a good fridge, and plenty of clean towels and paper towels.
A few notes: occasional sewage smell and cigarette smoke from shared vents; dark lobby with some bulbs out; construction noise next door in the mornings—light sleepers may want to check status. One bedroom has no AC, so summer guests may need to keep its door open. Check-in info wasn’t sent 24 h ahead, and local law requires sharing passport details to host to register in their system.

Overall, we had a good stay, but there were a few issues.
We received the apartment later than the agreed check-in time because it was still being cleaned. The living room had only one small air conditioner, which wasn’t powerful enough to cool the space properly. The hallway wasn’t very clean, and there was even tea left in the teapot, despite our request for a clean apartment. Also, only one of the two bedrooms had air conditioning, while the other was very hot.
On the positive side, the location was excellent, with easy access to the metro and nearby shopping centers.

Konum çok iyi, temizlik iyiydi, çarşaflar ve havlular temizdi, eve giriş sorunsuzdu, şu sıralar sanıyorum bitişik blokta inşaat durumu var ses rahatsız edici olabilir bizi çok etkilemedi. Biz mutfak malzemelerini kullanmadık ama biraz eski gibiydi. Kağıt-havlu terlik verilirse iyi olabilir. Küçük odada biz pek sorun yaşamadık ama karanlık ve dar bir oda. Ev sahibi iletişimi yönlendirmesi gayet iyi. Fiyat performans olarak gayet başarılıydı.

In the beginning Emre was so friendly and very responsive, the flat was excellent and exactly like what he explained in his post , location wise is more than perfect as the mall entrance just few meters across the road, the flat was so clean you'll get get everything you need, the only downside was the internet as it was bad , I'll highly recommend this flat and will definitely comeback.

description:
Would you like a perfect stay at the heart of Istanbul's historic peninsula?

This booking offers a fully equipped luxury apartment on Bogazkesen, the Cultural Path connecting Galataport to the famous Istiklal Street. You will find historic monuments, galleries, antique stores, the best of local cuisine, vibrant nightlife and more just beside you.

With daily cleaning service and assistance for your concierge needs, this apartment is set to make your vacation memorable!

reviews.text:
Decent apartment with modern amenities and design. It wasn't a perfect stay, but it was worth the money.
👍 Perfect location. It's very walkable to the main sites and close to public transport stations and two ferry terminals. The area has a variety of cafes and restaurants.
👍 Spacious enough for two people.
👍 Easy access via an app on your smartphone.
👎 It is located on the basement floor, which felt stuffy upon entry. In winter, you cannot turn on the AC for cooling, so we ended up opening the windows. However, we found a lot of dust and spider webs on the windowsill. Sleeping with the windows open was impossible due to the noise from the street, so be aware of that.
👎 The lights next to the bed were not working. We asked the host to fix it, and she promised that an electrician would come the next day, but he never did.
👎 Yes, there is a coffee maker, but there were no coffee capsules provided, not even one.

We’ve stayed here a couple of times now, and each experience has been consistently pleasant. The place is always clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The hosts are friendly, responsive, and make sure everything goes smoothly. It truly feels like a home away from home. We’d love to stay here again and definitely recommend it to others!
İlk andan son ana kadar Gülşah Hanımın iletişimi çok iyiydi, çözüm odaklıydı. Konakladığımız yer temiz ve problemsizdi. Bir sonraki İstanbul seyahatimizde aynı yerde kalmayı isteriz.

The apartment, in a word, is perfect.
Everything is very clean and very new.
The neighborhood is quiet and pleasant. Public transportation is very close; there's a tram every 5 minutes that takes you downtown in 10 minutes. The ferry is a 10-minute walk away. There's a bakery right next door. Restaurants are very close by.
I recommend it!

description:

we had a very pleasant stay at the hotel , the host is very nice and helpful they are reachable 24/7 one call away ,the room is super clean and tidy and has everything you need for your stay .

i would totally recommend this place for anyone whos looking for a clean affordable place to stay while in istanbul.

Book your stay today and experience the charm of Şişli from your own private garden retreat!

description: Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located quiet place. reviews.text: Amazing location. Clean spot. Tiny and Cozy. Accessible pretty much to everywhere. Lively area. Classic and historical. Walkable to public transportation and Ortakoy. Our brother Mohammed was very responsive and helped out with several local matters and transportation options, so definitely giving credit to him in early check in and prompt communication. Cheers to brother Gökhan as well for being clear and presenting the place exactly as it is in the pictures.

Gökhan is an outstanding host warm, welcoming, and genuinely attentive. He’s always checking in to make sure we have everything we need and goes out of his way to be helpful. His professionalism and kindness made us feel truly cared for throughout our stay. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and responsive, making everything smooth and hassle-free. Would definitely stay again. Highly recommend!

I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, and convenient place to stay near Taksim. We would happily stay here again! ❤️

Great stay at Pera Homes! The neighborhood was lovely, the apartment felt safe and clean, and the hosts were always responsive when we needed to get in touch. We had a lovel time and would absolutely recommend to friends.

Apartments close to Taksim Square. We traveled by car and had a free parking space in front of the building.
