description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place in the heart of Kadiköy/ Moda.

Our apartment is located on the high ground floor, you can easily enter/exit and carry your luggage.

Just a minute walk to cafes and restaurants.

Before each reservation, our apartment is cleaned by a professional cleaning company and clean towels, bed linen are provided.

The apartment and all the equipment has been completely renovated on January 2025.

reviews.text: This cozy apartment exactly matched the description and surpassed our expectations in terms of how close it is to everything. It was 2-4 minutes walking distance to supermarkets, cafes, and restaurants, 5-10 minutes to parks and coastal lines, 12-15 minutes to the main Kadıköy ferry, metro, and bus terminals. The apartment was quiet compared to the hustle and bustle of Kadıköy while still being very close to everything. This added so much value to our trip and made it this much easier. The apartment is very clean, the hosts are extremely friendly, very responsive, and accommodating. Overall, we absolutely loved our stay and will be staying again if we ever come back.

Konum gerçekten aşırı iyiydi, Kadıköy’ün tam merkezinde 😍 Her yere çok rahat ulaştık. Ev de tertemizdi, çok düzenli ve fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. İçeride ihtiyaç olan her şey vardı, çok rahat ettik. Ev sahibi de çok ilgili ve kibardı. Genel olarak her şey 10/10’du, kesinlikle tekrar kalırız 🙏

I appreciated the easy, friendly communication. The apartment was clean and comfortable, and the location was terrific. It’s a great place to have peace and quiet in Moda, but to be a short quick walk from everything the neighborhood has to offer.

Great place to stay — clean, quiet, and centrally located. The host was very attentive. I can definitely recommend it!

Ibrahim is a great host. I can’t say enough good things about him. He communicated with us very well. Asked him for a few extra supplies for the kitchen. They were there the next day we love the apartment very clean had everything we needed and more such a great house such a great place and the location was perfect. It was close to all the shops and restaurants. Thank you once again, Ibrahim.

description: Escape to The Mayda Sultan, a charming studio in historic Istanbul's Old City. Perfect for two, this retreat features ornate, traditional decor with elegant gold trim. Enjoy a cozy double bed, a convenient kitchenette, and a modern bathroom. You're just a short walk from Istanbul's most famous historical and touristic spots. An unforgettable cultural experience awaits!

reviews.text:
I would give it a 4 stars if there hadn't been cockroaches. We saw cockroaches daily, and since it is a relatively small space, they were everywhere, kitchen, bathroom and bedroom.
But apart from that and the smell of cigarettes that came in the room when we opened the windows, it was a good place. Close to restaurants, walkable distance from the historic centre, accessible my metro (15min walk), not noisy, calm and safe. AC worked well. Hasan was responsive and helpful.

Cozy appartment for a short time stay. Lots of restaurants and a few markets nearby. There is no noise from outside, though the place can be sometimes noisy due to its location on ground floor and people going and out or going up and down the stairs located just by the door. A few times there was a power supply outage which affected the whole street, the reason was unclear and hopefully this doesn't happen often. Hasan was very friendly and helpful, checkin and checkout went smooth. Overall I recommend the place for a short stay
Lovely apartment in a great location! Very clean and comfortable, with everything we needed. The host was kind and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay and would happily come back.

Bizi Ahmet qarsiladi cox terbiyeli semimi biriydi. ev sekildeki kimiydi hersey ter temiz. ne isdesek verdiler mehelle sakit her yere yaxin piyada gedis ucun evden cixib sola donen kimi kumkapi qatari var her yere yaxin taksiye ehtiyac yoxdu.
sabiha hava limanindan metroyla ayrilik cesmesine ordan marmarayla yeni kapiya gedin tekrar marmarayla kumpakidan cixsaniz mehellenin basina catirsiz cox rahat. tekrar gelsek burani nezerimde saxliyacam

It was nice stay. It’s clean apartment. And located near all the main attractions and public transport stops. There was few moments like electric sockets were out of theirs places and there was a bit smelly, cause it’s ground floor. Overall I think it’s good place for the money and the host is answering fast to your requests.

description:
6 minutes walking away from Taksim square metro station close to the main attractions.

It is located on the 3rd floor of a building WITHOUT an elevator. The staircase is narrow and steep. Please consider this before making a reservation.

It’s an older, authentic neighborhood where local residents live not a newly renovated area. If you are looking for a local, budget-friendly experience in the heart of the city, this place is a great match.

reviews.text:
It’s unfortunate that Örza’s apartment is in the middle of a freshly started construction zone, which led to water-stop (10am-2pm) twice within our 7-day stay.
Despite the water and noise issues caused by the construction zone (which is totally beyond her ability), her place is still worth (or even more than) every penny we paid:
- location: 5min walk to Taksim square, restaurant/pub/grocery all walkable within 10-15 min
- cleanness: absolutely amazing, the bathroom looks freshly renovated and she is very thoughtful with the bathroom-supplies.
- communication: she is extremely responsive and quick in actions. She fixed things for us twice: once when we arrived, the apartment was without electricity, she called (at 9PM !!!!) and the company got it done within 90mins. Another time, I broke the door handle, and she just changed it herself within 24 hrs.
- inside the apartment: it’s spacious and the AC is STRONG. Shower water was warm and the water pressure is perfect.

I had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Istanbul. Everything was exactly as described, if not better. The flat was clean, comfortable, and very well-equipped with everything I needed for a relaxing stay. The location was perfect close to major attractions, public transport, and plenty of great restaurants and cafes.
The host was friendly, responsive, and made the whole experience smooth from check-in to check-out. I especially appreciated the attention to detail and the welcoming atmosphere of the space.
Overall, I couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay. I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul and would happily stay here again!

Özra was super responsive (we texted before, during, and after my 11 day stay), friendly, and helpful. The apartment was adorable, light, well equipped, homey, and comfortable (the air conditioning worked great while it was hot outside). The kitchen/living room window faces west, so I got great sunsets during my stay. No TV, and the "couch" is really only big enough for one person, but why are you visiting Istanbul to sit on the couch? The surrounding neighborhood is a little rough, but I never felt uncomfortable or in danger, and it's about a 30 second walk to a major street. There are mini markets all over, including one with an adjacent butcher shop right outside. I'd absolutely stay here next time I'm in Istanbul.

I loved the stay at Ozra’s. The local neighborhood fulfills all my imagination about instanbul and beyond. It’s a great apartment/location to experience such a wonderful and amazing city.
The apartment is absolutely beautiful with a nice view and Ozra has a great taste decorating it. It’s also fully equipped with all amenities one would need.
Ozra has also been very helpful and responsive before the arrival and throughout my stay.
Two things to note:
it’s on 3rd floor of a walk up building and the staircase is quite narrow and steep.
The local neighborhood gives you a real flavor of the Istanbul culture - the street noise would last till quite late.

Great place, actually looks better than on the photos! Stunning view out of the kitchen window. So much going on in this lively neighborhood, cats walking the roofs, seagulls flying meters away from you and locals just living their life. You are truly getting a local experience by choosing to stay at Özra's place. We were very happy with our choice.

description: Bright and spacious 1BR apartment in Taksim360 with a rare 63m² net living area and elegant bay window seating. Sleeps 4 with a queen-size bed and a comfy sofa bed. Full kitchen, Smart TV, high-speed Wi-Fi, washer/dryer, and safe. Just a 5-minute walk to Istiklal Street, Taksim Square, and the metro. Easy access to Kabataş pier for ferries to the Asian side and tram to Sultanahmet. Perfect for couples, friends, or long stays. Crib/high chair available upon request.

reviews.text:
We absolutely loved our stay and couldn’t have been happier with our choice. The apartment was excellent: modern, stylish, very well furnished, and equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay. It was spotlessly clean upon arrival, and the attention to detail was evident throughout the property. The shower was great, the bed was very comfortable, and everything matched the photos perfectly.
The location is outstanding, just a few minutes’ walk from Taksim Square, with easy access to public transportation, restaurants, shops, and many of the city’s main attractions. It was the perfect base for exploring Istanbul.
Our host was exceptional—friendly, responsive, helpful, and always available whenever we needed assistance. The kindness and warmth of the host and staff made us feel genuinely welcome and at home from the moment we arrived.
The value for money is excellent and exceeded our expectations in every way. We would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Istan

This apartment is located in a very quiet side of the street, which was a plus because the area is very busy and noisy, so you can get a good night sleep. The other plus about this place is having the elevator!
The apartment is very clean, beautifully decorated, has a sofa bed. Having a dishwasher and washing machine for laundry was a blessing.
I have to give lots of credit to Berrak, the manager. She went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable and memorable! I am very grateful to her with her communication skills.
An extra tips about this place; there is a tiny store, down the alley, 2 minutes walk to this building, which has everything that you need, from drinking water to yummy cheese and other dairy products and bread so you don’t have to carry food for a long period, if you don’t have a car.
Yes, I highly recommend this apartment. It made our stay in Istanbul very pleasant and comfortable.

We recently stated at Dose Aparments. The communication with hosts were great from booking the place till leaving. Mr. Umit personally met us at the front of the apartment for totally hassle free checkin. He is one of the nicest person I have ever met. Once during our stay, he got out of a movie theater late in the evening to reply to my question. I can't say enough good things about him. He again personally met us on the morning of our checkout to help with yet again an easy and pleasent checkout experience.
The place is extremely clean,located in a very nice quiet neighborhood and it is close to all major locations a visitor might need to access. The place is much nicer and comfortable than it looks in pictures.
We indeed had nice, comfortable and enjoyable stay at this apartment. I would highly recommend others to stay at this place. Thanks Umit and the rest of the Dose Aparments team for letting us stay at your place and all your kind help during our stay.

The place was accurately as described, exactly same as the pictures. Location is great walkable to taksim and many shops around. Very clean and safe building and apartment. Great at communication and Umit was very helpful at check-in. Only small problem is during the week days there was construction back side of the building during the morning time. Otherwise, everything was great. Will definitely stay there again.

We had an incredible experience staying at this modern and spacious condo in Taksim 360, Istanbul. The location couldn't be more perfect—just a short walk to Istiklal Street, where you can explore the local charming Turkish cafes, restaurants, and local shops. Taxi and buses are easily accessible, making it effortless to travel the city.
The condo itself was immaculate, beautifully designed, quiet, and incredibly comfortable. Every detail has been thoughtfully considered, from the bathroom amenity kits to the well-equipped kitchen stocked with everything you could need—including even laundry soap! Safety was never a concern, as the building felt secure and welcoming.
Our host was simply amazing, offering timely support whenever needed and providing fantastic recommendations for local dining. Their hospitality made our stay even more enjoyable, ensuring we felt right at home.
We will absolutely be back for our next visit to Istanbul and highly recommend this condo for your trip.

description: Comfortable studio for two people. It contains a large double bed . It also has a fully equipped kitchen and a small balcony. The studio is quiet and safe, close to the city center, with Taksim Square being about a five-minute walk away. It is also close to the bus station and the metro station.

reviews.text: The host was helpful throughout my stay and the room looked exactly as described in the listing. Also, the location was ideal as it was walkable to most of touristic places l needed to visit nearby.

This place is the best in the area, very close to Taksim square and Istiklal street with a lot of restaurants, supermarkets and shops nearby… Ali the host was very friendly and he was flexible with the check-in timing… the place is super clean and nice, everything functions perfectly… I would definitely comeback here again!!!

Her şey güzeldi. Mutfaktaki eşyalar yemek yapmak için yeterli, tuzunuzu ve yağınızı alıp gidebilirsiniz. Evdeki eşyalar daha temiz ve yeni olabilirdi, ama bu yine de konaklamamıza engel değil. Konumu güzel, hem marketlere hem de meydana yakın. İletişim ve giriş çıkışlar konusunda sıkıntı yaşamadık çok teşekkür ederiz, sessiz ve rahat edebileceğiniz güzel bir ortam, tavsive ederiz...
Gayet temiz ve güzeldi çalışanlar ilgili ve güler yüzlü konumu meydana yakın tercih edebiliceğiniz bir yer

genel olarak iyiydi girişte daireyi gösteren arkadaş biraz vurdum duymazdı. evde ihtiyaç olabilecek her türlü şey neredeyse var mutfakta olanak çok. konum çok güzel bir yerde değil. ama idare eder temizlik bir kaç noktada leke ve tozlar vardı fakat genel olarak iyiydi

description: We are Mayer Property Management company with over 100 apts in our portfolio. Welcome to your stylish home in the heart of Istanbul! Our 3Br Duplex apt in the city center is located in Sisli and has easy access to all attractions, hip restaurants & cafes in its neighborhood.—one of Istanbul’s most vibrant and central neighborhoods. Just a short walk from public transport, shops, cafes, and major attractions, it’s the perfect base for exploring the city. We look forward to hosting you here.

reviews.text:
The host was very responsible and responded promptly to every question—no long waiting times. I’ve been to Turkey many times before, and this was by far the best place I’ve stayed. It’s located in the heart of Istanbul, close to everywhere you’d want to go.
The apartment we rented was just a few minutes’ walk from the Osmanbey Metro Station and very close to Taksim Square, a popular destination for visitors. There are plenty of restaurants and coffee shops nearby, making the location ideal.
The apartment was exceptionally clean, just as the host described—brand new and well-maintained. It had three separate air conditioning units, all functioning perfectly and keeping the space comfortably cool.
Thank you to Mayer for being a great host. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking to rent as a family or with a group of friends. The location and overall experience were excellent.

We had an amazing stay at this 3-bedroom apartment in Şişli. The location is perfect—just a few minutes’ walk from the metro station, which made it incredibly easy to get anywhere in the city. Everything you need is close by, from shops and restaurants to daily essentials.
The apartment itself is spacious, clean, and very comfortable. Self check-in and checkout were smooth and convenient, making the whole experience hassle-free. The building also has an elevator, which added to the comfort, especially with luggage.
Overall, a fantastic place to stay in Istanbul. Highly recommended

I had a great stay at this apartment!
It was clean, cozy, and well-furnished — just like the photos. The location is lively and close to everything, and the apartment is fully equipped with all essentials. The host was very responsive and helpful I felt very comfortable and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!
Perfect location, nice host and just like photos. Bonus for the floor planning with bedrooms far from the main street and two toilets.

The house was excellent.
I highly recommend it.
Great access to everything—metro, buses, and shopping.
Truly much better than many hotels we’ve stayed at before.
Especially perfect for families.

description:
Our property takes place in the center of Besiktaş , Akaretler area.
200 meters to Seaside, 50 meters to the Center.
Walking distance to public transport, Lütfü Kırdar Convention center, Dolmabahçe, Nişantaşı.

reviews.text:
The location is good, walkable. Close to Besiktas square and public transpo. Busy street, so you can find a taxi easily too. But it was surprisingly quiet at night. I kept the windows closed, might be why.
The code didn't work for me when I first arrived but the hosts were very quick to respond and help. I was inside within like 5 mins or less.
It could always be cleaner. A window cleaner can be left in the bathroom for guests to wipe the shower to avoid accumulation of water on the glass. The sheets looked and felt clean but they smelled vaguely of cigarettes. There was also an occasional cigarette smell in the room, probably coming through AC or some vent.
The shower had good water pressure. Didn't use the kitchen. The pillows (4) and mattress were good. My room was spacious. It was a bit dark though. The lights were very dim.
I'd stay there again depending on my budget.

Fantastic place right in the heart of the city. Safe and secure neighborhood with lots of shops, cafes and restaurants to visit.
Room was clean, linens were clean and bed was comfortable. Room was spacious and as exactly as it was described.

I stayed here for three nights, and everything was excellent. The host was very helpful and responsive. The apartment looks exactly like the pictures and description. What impressed me most was how clean it was—thank you for keeping it that spotless!
The only small downside for me was the lighting. Although there are two windows, they don’t let in much natural light. But that’s just a personal preference, and I don’t think it would be an issue for most guests.
The location is also perfect—there are plenty of cafés nearby, and you can reach Dolmabahçe in about 10 minutes.
Thank you so much to the host, and I wish you all the best!

We stayed at this apartment in Beşiktaş for over two weeks, and it was a great home base for exploring Istanbul. The location is excellent — close to everything in Beşiktaş, with easy access to ferries, transport, and the Bosphorus. The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped for an extended stay.
The host was incredibly helpful and hospitable throughout our stay, always quick to respond and happy to help with anything we needed. It really made the trip smoother knowing we could count on them.
Overall a wonderful experience — highly recommend this place for anyone looking to stay in Beşiktaş, especially for a longer trip.
Very kind and helpful hosts, with a clean and comfortable place. The location was also very easy to reach. We were very pleased.

description: Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun.

reviews.text: Great place to stay with my family. Accommodation matches the fair price. The location worked great for my family of 7 and the host tried to resolve any issues we might have had. The family that owns the apartment and lives downstairs is very kind.

great property! in a great area with accessible transport links and for taxis. nice shops and food places nearby and very friendly helpful neighbours in the area that gave us great recommendations. whenever we had a problem, we got a response straight away !! thank you for making our trip to Istanbul perfect

Le logement est comme sur les photos, proche de la place Eyupsultan, une place elle même touristique et d'où nous avons pu prendre les transports en commun pour visiter Istanbul. Il met même à disposition un parking privé, ce qui est un grand plus !
Le quartier est agréable, calme, et plusieurs magasins sont à proximité.
L'hôte est réactif, et toujours là pour aider si besoin.
Les voisins sont adorables !
Nous conseillons vivement pour les familles !
Genel anlamda fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi, konumu gayet iyi , güvenli bir alandı . Yürüme mesafesinde market ve fırın olması oldukça avantajlıydı, temizlik açısından biraz daha iyi olabilir.

Konumu çok güzeldi.Ev sahibinin iletişimi çok güzeldi.Aile ile kalmak için müthiş bir yer.Şahsen biz ailecek çok beğendik ve ev fazlaca büyük.Sıcak bir ortam evinizde gibi oturabilirsiniz.Komşular güleryüzlü.Ne zaman görsek selam verdiler.Selma hanıma Herşey için çok teşekkür ederiz.

description:
Our Fitaş Oda Hotel is located in the heart of Istiklal Avenue, one of the most iconic spots in Istanbul, inside the Fitaş Passage. Our passage offers many fun activities such as fast food restaurants, concert venues (Hollystone Beyoğlu, Faculty Terrace), bowling alley and playground.

We are delighted to welcome you for a stylish and comfortable stay right in the center of the city!

reviews.text: Unfortunately the hotel was disgusting. There was hair on the walls and the shower was completely broken and taped up. Someone shaved and left little hairs all over the shower wall and they never bothered to clean it up before our stay. There was something that looked like mold near the sink and a terrible smell in the bathroom. The host did not respond to our concerns until we got Airbnb involved. The only good things were that the staff was nice and the location was great. But definitely not worth the money, they need serious maintenance.

My stay at Büşra’s place in Taksim was absolutely fantastic. The room was exactly like the photos—actually, even better! It was spotlessly clean, beautifully presented, and incredibly comfortable. The location is unbeatable—just a few meters from İstiklal Street, right in the heart of the city. You’re within walking distance of restaurants, cafes, shops, the metro, and tram lines, making it super easy to explore every part of Istanbul.
Büşra and her team were incredibly hospitable, friendly, and always ready to help with anything I needed. They were supportive, professional, and truly made me feel at home. It’s rare to find a place that offers such quality, comfort, and convenience for such a reasonable price. This is a real bargain, and I would absolutely stay here again.

Nothing matches the photos they show in here....
First night in room 42.
The lock was broken, the door could easily open from anyone!
A/C did not work, the filters were dirty and the cold air (instead of hot) coming out smelled awful cigarette. We slept in cold...
Lights where not all working...
rust on metal surfaces especially in bathroom door..
Next morning i asked for a room change. The new room had bad lighting, it was dark, rust again, and TV did not work.
The stuff and reception did their best to sort all issues, but the place needs maintenance..
The location of the hotel though, is the best i could ever wanted. Excellent location.
in overall, i would not book there again!

Room was different than on the pictures. It was extremely loud due to music from bars on the street until 5:00 am. The place was damp/moldy and the hearing didn’t work, it was cold. The bed had stains.
Overall, cannot recommend.
Location is central but the noise and general condition made it unstayable.
We checked out early and changed to another place.
Konumu, temizliği, fiyatı, her şeyiyle mükemmel bir yer. Gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz.

description: Nice well-decorated one bedroom 65m2 apartment, all-equipped, inside a secured residence. There are nearby services and a wonderful park! High speed internet, Live TV application includes worldwide satellite channels, movies, and series. Heating and air-conditioning available. One A/C in the living room. Free parking. Grocery store within the residence.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this apartment and couldn’t be happier with our experience. The apartment was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, well-equipped, and beautifully maintained. The location was excellent, making it easy to get around and enjoy the area.
The host was friendly, responsive, and made sure everything went smoothly from check-in to check-out. We felt very welcome and appreciated all the thoughtful touches throughout our stay.
Overall, this was a fantastic experience, and we would highly recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a comfortable and enjoyable place to stay. We would definitely stay here again!
Great apartment, great location, and a very helpful host. Everything was clean and exactly as described. Highly recommended!

Kız arkadaşımla 3 gece geçirdik gerçekten süperdi. Konum metrobüs duragına taksiyle 10 dakika yürüyerek de yarım saat. İçeriğinin temizliği ve düzeni fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Gürültü ortami veya çalışmayan herhangi bir şey yoktu. Ev sahibinin yaklaşımı çok olumluydu.Bir daha gelsek yine burada kalırız. Site içinde güvenli bir ortam var. Çevrede File market, A101,Tekel gibi imkanlar var. Genel olarak çok güzel bir konaklama deneyimiydi. Tek eksikligini hissettigimiz mutfakta belki biraz daha tencere, Tava vb olabilir. Ufak bir tuz, baharat vb koymak icin tuzluk seti olabilir. Isıtma ve soğutma olarak klima sorunsuz çalışıyor. Sıcak su büyük problem teşkil ediyor,bir sıcak bir soguk geliyor. Onun dışında gerçekten her şey harikaydı.

good host and good place if you plan to be within the Esenyurt area. The place was clean, the fresh air and the view from the 24th floor is nice.
The place was clean and as shown in the pictures.

Her şey çok güzeldi. Ev genel olarak temizdi. Mutfak eşyaları gayet yeterliydi. Banyo temizdi. Televizyon büyük ve güzeldi. Etrafta çok market vardı. Ev sahibi mesajlara çok hızlı yanıt veriyordu ve sorunlarla ilgileniyordu. Genel olarak her şeyden çok memnun kaldık.

description: Enjoy a comfortable stay in our modern 65 m² residence within walking distance of Taksim Square. Cozy bedroom, bright living room, and fully equipped kitchen. Experience the comfort of a home with hotel-quality convenience and cleanliness. Located in a secure building with 24/7 security and elevator access, ideal for families, couples, and business travelers. Transport, restaurants, and shops are nearby, yet the area is peaceful and safe.

reviews.text: Amazing clean modern spacious place. Taksim square is a three min walk albeit being slightly uphill (very common in Istanbul). What stood out was how modern the building was . My 3rd time in Istanbul and this was the best airbnb I have stayed in the city . The apartment was spotless with plenty of light and a spacious living area. A 24/7 mart beneath the building was added bonus. Security personnel plus card access to enter and use the lift made it extremely secure despite being in a bustling corner ( so be prepared for sounds of emergency vehicles and police cars ) . The hosts were extremely helpful both during check out and check in . My only minor suggestion would be to add warm lights in the bedroom as well.Thank you for the amazing stay !

Really great place in a central location. This apartment also faces the main street so you get a ton of natural light. Other apartments might be facing an alleyway. It's centrally heated--two zones, one for the bedroom and one for the rest.
Has an oven for baking, stove tops work, washer + dryer. Washer was leaking due to a broken plastic seal but they looked into it fast.
Kitchen is well equipped. Instant hot water for showers 24/7. The team at Taksim Ligirio was also very helpful and friendly.
As for street noise it might vary. It's actually rather quiet for a main road but you will hear emergency vehicles passing by sometimes.
Overall it's a very nice, comfy place equipped with enough things that you can cook yourself if you don't feel like eating out everyday.

Very beautiful apartment, clean and spacious and plenty of sunlight. On a busy street but noise was not an issue as it’s well insulated. The management was professional and responsive, and were very quick to address a couple small requestes i have asked.
Location is very good, in a beautiful well maintained building, close to Taksim main street and surrounded by many stores that are open late. Highly recommended

I loved my stay at Ũġuřs. He was a great host. I loved how the place was in the middle of everything and yet it was peaceful and very clean. I had. Y own parking spot and Mohammed was very helpful and tentative with my requests.
I appreciate having me and taking care of me. The place was very clean and quiet. I definitely recommend this place to everyone who wants to be close to everything.

We had a great stay. The location is right behind Taksim square and a lot of sight see places are on walking distance. The hosts were wonderful to us, I’d really recommend. Thank you Uğur and Mohamad!

reviews.text: The check-in and accommodations were excellent. Kitchen utensils are available, and the refrigerator is free. Most importantly, there's free parking. The shower is excellent, and the complex has a swimming pool and a gym. Shops are nearby, so you can cook in the kitchen and there's a refrigerator. It's safe. There's a washing machine and air conditioning in the room. Everything was great, and we loved it.
Ev oldukça temiz ve düzenliydi. Konumu da çok iyiydi, ulaşım açısından rahat ettik. Ev sahibi ilgili ve hızlı dönüş yaptı. Konaklamamız genel olarak keyifli geçti.
güzel, temiz ve nezih bir yer. metrobüse ve avmye yakın. yatak başlığının hafif kırık olması, lavaboda kullanılan parfümün çok bunaltıcı olması ve en önemlisi şampuan olmamasından ötürü 4 yıldız.
The house was very dirty, disorganized, and in poor condition. Old towels and mattress covers, and poor host communication. I do not recommend it
Ev gözüktüğü gibi temiz ve ferahtı Burak beye teşekkür etmek istiyorum bizimle çok iyi ilgilendi 10/10 iletişim gönül rahatlığıyla konaklayabilirsiniz

description:
Enjoy a stylish experience in our centrally located apartment in the heart of Sultanahmet – just a 5-minute walk to the Hagia Sophia & Blue Mosque.

You can expect many cafés & restaurants in the immediate vicinity, self check-in, a personal guide with insider tips – and a 20% breakfast discount at the hotel next door!

We are a young couple from Germany and share our first Airbnb here – with everything we love ourselves: comfort, tranquility & real hospitality.

reviews.text: The apartment is perfect for a single person, a couple or two friends who like to cuddle. The biggest perk is location. You can easily walk to the blue mosque, hagia sophia, the grand bazaar and everything else on your list. Its also walking distance to the ferry station for Bosphorus cruises. Tram is a short walk from the apartment and you can take it to taksim, galata tower and karakoy. If you want to see the Asian side you could do day trips there easily. The restaurants and cafes close to the apartment are excellent and people in the area are helpful. In short if you want to fit as much into a short trip as possible or make a long trip more comfortable this is the place for you. Hosts were excellent, the place was very clean and I got to feel at home in a place far away. Please book :)

Our stay here was absolutely fantastic! The hosts were incredibly kind, responsive, and made everything so easy and comfortable. Communication was fast and helpful, and we felt very well taken care of throughout our stay.
The apartment itself was spotless, cozy, and even better than the photos. Everything was well thought-out, and we had everything we needed for a perfect trip.
And the location just unbelievable!!!! It couldn’t have been better

Comfortable bed and linens. Well equipped. Good storage. Good water pressure in the shower. Blackout curtains and soundproof windows are top notch. Elegantly appointed. Ideally located to access the hippodrome and beyond. Washer/dryer was very helpful. Perfect for a couple.

A fabulous apartment with everything we needed for a week in Istanbul. The washing machine and dryer were a bonus along with the resident cats out front. Close to all main attractions and plenty of restaurants outside the door.
Ufuk & Eda were fabulous hosts who always responded quickly. There were works in the street that interrupted power and hot water and we were kindly offered a complimentary breakfast at the nearby restaurant as compensation.
The onsite caretaker was also very helpful and friendly.
Thank you Ufuk & Eda for a wonderful experience in Istanbul.

reviews.text: We stayed here for a week, and the place was perfect for what we needed. The apartment is small and cozy, and it's a nice, clean, quiet place to refresh at the end of a busy day touring Istanbul. The photos look exactly like the apartment does in person, and the view from the unit is beautiful. Check-in was super smooth, and the hosts were exceptionally helpful and responsive. Even though our flight arrived late, they made a point to check in and make sure we got in alright. The neighborhood felt safe and secure, and while it's farther away from the typical tourist sites, it is within a 15-20 minute walk to Taksim Square and plenty of cool restaurants/bars/shops. Our only (minor) complaint was that it was a bit warm in the bedroom, but once we turned up the air conditioning it was comfortable. We would definitely recommend this place as a great home base for a trip to Istanbul!

The host was helpful, responsive, & gave clear check in instructions. They were quick to respond to any questions & were friendly and attentive. They offered local food recommendations & lots of things to do in the area! The host made sure I got my flights okay & was very caring and kind. The apartment is basic, but it has everything you would need, and is clean and tidy. The bed is very comfortable and the WiFi connection was very good. The apartment offers a great view of Istanbul. The apartment is about a 35/40 minuite walk from the Fındıklı-Mımar Sınan Ünıversıtesı tram station to get to the AyaSofya/ Sultan Ahmet Mosque, & about a 40 minuite walk to the Bosphorus shopping area. There are lots of restaurants & mini markets near the apartment to get any food/ groceries you need. The apartment is about 15 minuite walk from Taksim Square. The neighbourhood is very family-orientated & a traditional Istanbul style- it felt very safe. Definitely would stay again!:)

Very close to Teksim square you can take public transport (pay with your local credit/debit card) , or you can walk 10-15mins. All the main attractions are nearby if you use public transport. The place looks exactly like the photo, just smaller, by quite a lot, but it's still a nice and comfy place to stay in Istanbul. The neighbourhood is relatively quiet with some restaurants and mini-markets. However, the place is quite a distance from the main Istiklal Road, tram and bus stations. Overall, it was still a lovely experience. Thanks Fevziye!

The small balcony gives a nice little look out to the surrounding area. It is clean and quiet in the apartment and even had a small elevator which was convenient for bringing luggage in and out. reviews.text:
We spent a glorious month at the luxurious apartment on the second floor. It is hard to make a choice with so many options in Istanbul, but we feel so lucky that we choose this apartment! It is even better than In the pictures! This is the best possible combination of Airbnb with a hotel, because you have a wonderfully resourceful manager Hatiçe on hand in her downstairs office and a cleaning lady who spruces up your apartment daily!
Should you want to cook, the kitchen is equipped with absolutely everything you might possibly need, though with so many great food options within steps of our front door we only ever prepared breakfast. (You can get fresh baguettes and croissants at nearby MJet every morning).
I don’t want to go into every detail of this wonderful High end tasteful decorated design apartment, but want to say the whole house has been remodeled and refurbished with utmost taste and care for detail and materials. Marble, wood, brick!
The bed has a high quality mattress, the hot shower water in the bathroom is plentiful, the air conditioning works great. If you are a light sleeper do bring ear plugs, as the building is in the middle of lively locals plus tourist scene. With the school across the street and some nighttime revellers walking around at night it can be a bit lively at times. The street is just bellow Galata Tower, but luckily not on the main approach, so it is one of the less touristy streets, but still people do walk it at times, which can make it a bit loud but also makes it very safe any time of day or night. It is a a narrow one way street so very little car traffic!
We found the location perfect as it Is very easy to get to the metro or tram. It is still inhabited by local people and as there is an eye clinic close by you will see even people from the countryside come for surgery. Yet it has many wonderful (Cheap and expensive, your pick, but all delicious) restaurants, coffe shops, rooftop bars and Nardis Jazz club. For us a wining combination.
It is lovely to go up on the beautiful and comfortable roof terrace to enjoy a drink at sunset and see the skyline of the mosques and the water bellow.
For a longer stay you can use the washer and drier in the basement. The wifi works great on all floors of the building.
Upon our arrival we were welcomed with a basket of fruits and as we were celebrating birthday and wedding anniversary we were treated to wine and champagne with personal wishes from the owners Zeynap and her mom Salmin.
We were also lucky to meet them in person and have some wonderful conversations and get personal recommendations upon our particular interests.
There is so much to see and do in Istanbul, that a month was really not enough!

The apartment was exactly as described. Space was comfortable, clean, and very well located. Galata Tower is right up the hill and Istikal is a short walk away. Topkapi, Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque are within 20 minutes (walk + light rail). The ferry to the Asian side was 10 minutes away. Definitely get an istanbul Card, it grants easy access to the ferries, buses, and light rail.
The apartment itself was well air conditioned and pretty comfortable to live in. There can be some street noise on the weekends, but generally it's fairly quiet. The rooftop terrace is lovely and provides great views of Golden Horn. There are tables and a desk (for you digital nomads).
Lastly, but likely the most important. The staff was great! I stayed for a month and the apartment was cleaned weekly and I was able to get help with the most mundane of things via whatsapp or just walking into the office on the ground floor. There is a laundry access as well (you may want to bring some Tide Pods -- to wash the clothes, not to snack on -- the stores didn't really have travel sized detergents but it was cheap anyway) .

I was fortunate enough to stay at Zeynep's place for two months and it was easily one of the best Airbnb experiences I have ever had. Prior to my booking I requested information on the property and received prompt and accurate responses. The location is perfect. Right next to Galata tower and near plenty of restaurants, cafes and bars.
When I arrived I met Hatice who ensured I had a very comfortable stay. She was always easy to reach and took care of any issues right away. The property itself is as good as it gets. The building is historic and remodeled very tastefully to preserve its roots. The rooms are clean, comfortable, and quite charming. The WiFi speeds allowed me to work without any hiccups.
And then you get to the incredible rooftop. I cannot tell you how many pictures my friend and I took from there. The view is simply mesmerizing; even till my last day at the property I felt like I could never absorb enough of the sights from the terrace. We were also lucky enough to have met some really fun neighbors; the rooftop ended up becoming a great spot to meet up for drinks and coffee.
If you are visiting Istanbul, you cannot go wrong with this property. I look forward to booking again when I visit Turkey.

Zeynep's space is a dream, beautiful and historical unit. Up 2 flights of stairs, no elevator (not a big deal), because the marble stairs is a dream! The unit is updated, strong AC. Clean, attentive cleaning, and communication was so simple.
The space is central, a 5 minute walk up a slight incline to the Galata Tower. Many markets, restaurants around. You can purchase a sim card, get pizza, if you don't have a european charger, theres a shop on the same street.
My holiday was a dream. Will stay again. Also - the queen bed was very comfortable, and the TV has a chromecast.
10/10 will recommend and stay again.

Zeynep’s place far exceeded my expectations. I didn’t realize that it was so close to the Galata Tower. It’s perfectly located, being in walking distance to the tram, Galata Bridge, and Eminonu if you want to take a ferry. It’s also close to Istiklal and Taksim. Basically the location can’t be beat. The space itself is historic and lovely. The bedroom is spacious and the bathroom is clean and tidy. The kitchen is equipped with everything you need. There is also a terrace with beautiful views of Fatih. Communication was great. Hatice was responsive, and very helpful! My flight was in the evening and Zeynep was able to accommodate my request for a late check out, which was so nice! Overall I had a great experience! Thank you Hatice and Zeynep!

description: Our place is in the BEŞİKTAŞ bazaar and is on a quiet street. It is an 8-minute walk to the beach. There are many markets, cafes and restaurants around us where you can order food, and there are different alternative places to drink coffee. There is easy transportation from Beşiktaş beach to Ortaköy, Adalar, Kadıköy and the Grand Bazaar. We also have other apartments in the same building. Our house is prepared to meet all your needs. We also provide airport transfers.

reviews.text:
It is as central as it can be! A couple of minutes walk to the Besiktas market. 10-20 minutes walk to the Besiktas ferry terminal and the station of the shuttle to the new airport. And there is a convenience store downstairs right in front of your door which is open till late.
The place is clean and comfy. The red sofa you see in pictures turns into a large bed too and you can ask for extra sheets. The cleaning lady makes regular visits if you want.
There were a couple of plumbing issues that Hakan wanted to fix but I asked him to postpone it to after I leave. Hopefully they'd be done by the time of your visit!
Also, please be aware of the 2 stories of steep round stairs to the apartment, if you are caring for the elderly/disabled.
Overall a pleasant stay and is recommended.

A great location , we had a comfortable stay . This is not a tourist location , hence we truly enjoyed the cafes and clubs as locals. great spot for shopping as well. Just 500 mtrs from this place, sharing taxis are available to TAKSIM maidan , at 2.75 Lira. There was only one pan in the kitchen , so if you plan to cook meals , it can be a hassle. Also no elevator , you need to take stairs upto 2 floors. But Overall a great stay for me.

Pazar sabahı saat 9 civarı inatla kapımız açılmak istendi iç taraftan kilitlediğimiz için açamadılar birisi kapımıza anahtar takıp 5 dakika boyunca kapıyı açmaya çalıştı, ürkütücü.
Dış kapı zaten fiyasko sipariş veriyoruz ve almak için üç kat aşağı iniyoruz, odaların temizliği yetersiz terliksiz geldik ve çıkarken çoraplarımızı çöpe atmak zorunda kaldık :) içerideki teknolojik aletler eski banyo terliği yok duş havluları, terlikleri yarım yamalak hazırlanmış, yatak odasına uzanamadık bile çarşaf ve yorgan kıl,tüy içindeydi maksimum bir gece kalınacak bir yer yani daha düşük bir fiyat olsa eyvallah diyeceğimde fiyat performans açısından çok yetersiz. Beşiktaş’ta daha uygun fiyata çok daha temiz ve güvenilir yerlerde kaldık.
İşletme içi personel patron ilişkisi sıfıra inmiş bu konu ile ilgili daha önce hiç karşılaşmadığım bir durumla karşılaştım.
Maksimum bir gece konaklamak için gayet uygun daha fazlasında pişman olursunuz :)

Good location - Besiktas district. In 5 minutes, a pedestrian area with cafes, exchangers, a supermarket, a ferry stop, a bus station. In 15 minutes there is a tram stop and a funicular to the metro. Easy to get to the center. Nice, clean and spacious apartment with a fresh renovation. Quiet place - comfortable to sleep. The owner quickly responds and fulfills all wishes. If late departure, you can leave your luggage in a special room. I recommend.

This is a perfect place to stay in Besiktas, which is a great, lively neighborhood in Istanbul. The apartment was very clean and well equipped, and located very close to a huge variety of bars, cafes, and restaurants. There is one bed and one pull-out sofa couch. Highly recommend!

description:
A completely refurbished 2-storey lovely single house in a historical quarter of Istanbul- Bosphorus area.

A completely renovated, charming detached house in the historical Arnavutköy neighborhood.

reviews.text: I can not thank Lou enough for an incredible 10 night stay in her very special home! In arguably Istanbuls most beautiful picturesque suburb, Lou’s apartment is a 5 minute walk into the lively bars and restaurants of Arnavutkoy and another 2 minutes to the water. I did daily walks to Bebek along the water, stopping to take in the view while enjoying a coffee or ice cream on the go. Lou was very responsive, regularly checking in on me, her home is meticulously clean, and as described. She has seriously thought of everything you could need during your stay! Thankyou Mutlu hanım for everything it was a perfect stay and I can’t wait to come back!

Amazing place with an unmatched view over the Bosporus. It's like a little private house with two bedrooms downstairs and a large beautiful living room upstairs.
It has everything you need plus an amazing host. The neighborhood is just too beautiful and gives endless picture options for posting, as well as for food and coffee. To get to the historic center, you take a boat which is entertaining in itself. You ride along the Bosporus shore with beautiful landscapes for the price of a cookie.
We highly recommend this jewel of a place in one of the most beautiful cities we've been to!

It was a dream place... Shining, cozy, warm, home feeling atmosphere, romantic, spectacular view of the breathtaking Bosphorus. I could watch for hours the beautiful boats with aromatic coffee in my hands, which I found and prepared in that chic kitchen.Very clean and comfortable house. In the kitchen and the whole house, I found everything I needed.
I was welcomed by Lou (amazing person) , who was so kind to show me around and to help me find everything I needed - tasty food, the nice coffee places, a close-by Bosphorus beautiful walk side (Thank you so much). Perfect location - not too crowded, calm, safe neighborhood.
I had the best experience ever.

Wonderful stay! The view from the apartment is amazing. perfect to unwind after a day of sightseeing. Great location with easy access to buses to Beşiktaş and Kabataş. The neighborhood feels truly local and authentic. The apartment was very clean, everything worked well and the Wi-Fi was reliable. Lou was a kind and helpful host, flexible with check-in and very respectful.
Only small note: one of the single beds made a bit of noise – nothing major.
Highly recommended!

The stay at Mutlu's house was one of my best airbnb experiences. She is was very easy to communicate with, informative and attentive to all my requests for a pleasant stay at her place. She was prompt to let me into the house and also willing to inform me about the area. The house is very conveniently located, close to shopping, beautiful Bosphorous, pubs, cafes and restaurants in a safe area with easy access to parking. I was also able to enjoy my daily morning walks by the Bosphorous which is a ten minute walk to Mutlu's house. The house its self is very tastefully decorated, homy, cosy , spacious, super clean with a stunning view of the Bosphorous. It also has everyting from TV, to wireless internet, from all kictchen utentils to beautiful bed covers. Not to forget an amazing book collection and fresh flowers. I am already looking forward to my next visit at Mutlu's house. It is a gem of a place. Thank you Mutlu for such a wonderful stay in Istanbul. I felt completely at ease and at home.

description: The apartment is in residential building, guests have to be respectful between 23:00pm-09:00am. The apartment is located in Taksim, close to famous Istiklal Street which is very centre of the city with shops, cafes, bars, galleries. It has 3 bedrooms with equipped kitchen. It's minutes away to all public transport. It's on the 7th floor, protecting by digital security system & has a sunny private terrace with beautiful sunset view.

reviews.text:
Taylan was a fantastic host, sharing lots of information prior to the location, nearby places and how to get around. Also great details of the property such as how to find it, how to enter, WiFi details etc... The flat is very pretty and is kept clean, we had a very comfortable stay here.
The flat is up a long spiral staircase, but this is mentioned in the comments (hence the lovely rooftop!) and so we prepared for this by packing a smaller 'overnight bag' and dropping our suitcases to the luggage opposite. I would recommend the same for other guests here.

Location was great, close to public transport & easy to reach the city center. Also stunning view from the rooftop, which made the apartment well worth it. However, when we wanted to check in (1h after 3pm) the cleaning lady was not finished with the apartment and we had to wait. Once we checked in, one control for the AC was missing, we had help finding it, however the AC in the bedroom did not work. The furniture in the living room has tears & bed in the 2nd bedroom is close to falling apart. also there was no drying towel in the kitchen & the bathroom (although looks beautiful, water pressure was great) just smells moldy. First day, we did not have running water, last day electricity did not work for a moment.

Wonderful first time in Istanbul; this apartment was exactly as described- very clean, in a part of the city that is very lively, with a hustle and bustle feel. Live music; outdoor cafes and shops, narrow streets. The apartment is up 7 flights of stairs- we got our work out for sure, and this is something to consider when you have large luggage or if you’re elderly or are out of shape post pandemic (hello!), but we packed smart. Neighborhood is lively, tons of live music, restaurants. We were 3 women, and felt very safe, even walking alone at night. Lots going on, and people were helpful but also leave you alone. A few cafes directly across the street, and we were worried about noise, but this apartment was quiet, lively terrace on the top floor which was beautiful. Would recommend, but definitely consider the 7 flights of stairs if you’re staying for a long time, or if you are someone who goes back and forth to your hotel/air bb throughout the day.
The apartment had 3 rooms; but only one room had an AC. This is also something to consider if you need cold or cool air to sleep. However; the unit in the living room is a split box; so we used the hosts fans, and the rooms really were perfect sleeping temperature.
The best part of this was the host, he was reachable by text apps pretty much immediately. He helped with car transfers to and from the airport and responded literally within minutes when we had questions (even silly ones). Loved the experience and thank you!

Our stay at this Airbnb had its ups and downs, but overall, it was a good experience. The flat is located on the top floor, which means an amazing view but also a LOT of stairs to climb, as there’s no elevator. It was quite the challenge, but the view made it worth it!
The flat has a charming vintage vibe and was very clean, which we appreciated. However, there were a few issues: the bathroom had a strange smell that lingered, and the beds were quite noisy and not stable, making it a bit tricky to get a comfortable night’s sleep.
What truly stood out was Taylan’s incredible hospitality. He was an amazing host, always quick to respond to any questions or requests, and even went the extra mile by getting us a dessert—such a thoughtful touch!
Despite the challenges, we enjoyed our stay and appreciated the effort put into making it a welcoming experience.
Thank you Taylan!!
Rating: 4/5

I would definitely recommend this AirBnb for people wanting to explore Istanbul - good location and easily accessible to the airport. there were lovely bars and restaurants close, a beautiful Hammam and shops/amenities all within minutes. Taylan was responsive and helpful. the rooms were clean, comfortable and just like the pictures. this lovely old building has loads of character and we had a great stay.
one piece of advice - If you choose to stay here you must be fit and mobile as there are a lot of stairs to the air BnB, it's on a steep hill with cobbles and has a steep narrow stairway to the balcony.

description:
Nordic Room is a spacious and simple room that I made available recently. 😄
Very central location 10 minutes to seaside and 5 minutes to main metro line with Bogazici University station.
Great for short and long term stays and I am very flexible and accommodating with time arrangements.
Reach out if interested.
Thank you!✌🏻

reviews.text:
As an Erasmus student from Bogazici University, I would highly recommend to rent this place for your stay. It is close to the university (15 min walk max) and most students hang out in the area, so you are never far away from a good party or conversation with fellow university students.
On the pictures, the room seems small, but it is way bigger in real life. Hakan is a friendly host and is very welcoming. He responds fast and only wants the best for his guests. He makes sure to put your needs first, which makes him an incredible host. I must say, that during my stay here I have gained a new friend in him.
Truth be told, the place is on the bottom of a small hill, which should be no problem for any person who is able to walk normally. It should not be seen as a disadvantage though, since within 5 minutes you are surrounded by shops as well as the Bogazici Metro Station.
To end, I would recommend this stay to anyone ranging from students to other visitors of Istanbul as well.

Great home and lovely host! 🥰 I really enjoyed my time at Hakan’s place 👌🏻 Very responsive host. It looked better than the pictures. Convenient and central location. I’m definitely coming back. Thank you!

Overall enjoyed my stay here, the white aesthetic in the house was calming. Hakan as a host was very accessible and accommodating. The location of the place is also one of the best in the Istanbul area. Would come again and again when in Istanbul!
Hakan Bey misafirperver ve dost canlisi bir ev sahibiydi. Konumu ve evi de guzeldi, Istanbul'da rahat bir sekilde kalabilecegim evlerdendi. Hicbir sorun yasamadik, tesekkur ederiz🥰
Hakan is a great host and the bedroom where I stayed was very spacious and comfortable. You really feel like with friends when you are staying here…

description:
Enjoy a bright and comfortable apartment in Cihangir, one of Istanbul's most popular neighborhoods.
A shared rooftop terrace with city views, a fully equipped kitchen, two bedrooms, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere.
Within walking distance of all transportation, it's an ideal starting point for those looking to experience the city's energy.
I'd be happy to welcome you to my cosy home

reviews.text:
This beautifully decorated and clean apartment is conveniently located near places to eat (amazing local bakery/ice cream place just a stone's throw away) and a 10-15min walk to public transport (be aware you have to walk uphill from the metro stop).
Taksim square is a 15min walk.
The kitchen is well equipped, rooms are spacious enough, bathroom very clean, linen and towels also clean. Zeynep provided fans for every room and there is aircon in the dining/living area (and of course heating for winter). Beds are comfy and we slept well. Apartment is safe. Neighbourhood is lively with a school nearby. Some noise at night but didn't bother us. There is a lift but it is small and can fit max 3 persons (squished in) but good to have for luggage. Apartment is on the 2nd floor. Terrace at the top with a great view. Garbage is cleared daily when put outside (except Sunday)
Zeynep as a host is communicative and would check in regularly to ask if we needed anything and ask how we were doing.

Zeynep’s place is gem. Cihangir is a boisterous but engaging neighbourhood, with many restaurants, coffee shops, and mid-size grocery stores nearby. It is a 15 minute downhill walk to Tram line 1, which connects to all major attractions. And taking T1 back to the Funicular and then to Taksim Square means a walk downhill to home. And a wonderful home it is. The description is accurate and it seems larger than the photos. The beds are comfortable and the kitchen has all you need. The shower is good, and the bathroom, like the apartment was spotless. There’s an abundance of outlets to charge your devices and decent wifi. Naci, the on-site manager made us welcome, and we’d often meet him on the terrace with the amazing views . Forget that adapter? You’ll find one. In fact, Zeynep has thought of everything. From the instructions for using the appliances to finding what you need, to getting into the apartment, Zeynep’s notes are peerless. A real Super Host. Book it.

10/10! From the spacious apartment to the fabulous location to the well stocked kitchen to the comfortable beds and great shower pressure, Zeynep’s place was an amazing place to stay in Istanbul. Don’t hesitate to book immediately if her place is free. Apartment bigger than photos suggest. Great restaurants and cafes in the area but the street is quiet enough that you don’t get much noise from the street (though street facing bedroom gets a bit more than the back bedroom). Kitchen is one of the best stocked I’ve ever had at an AirBnB. Communication with Zeynep was always quick and helpful. Would no doubt stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Istanbul and highly recommend it. The location is excellent, about a 10–15 minute walk to Istiklal Street and Galata Port, with many grocery stores, cafés, and restaurants close by.
The apartment is a spacious two-bedroom for 4 people on the 2nd floor, and having a small elevator was a big plus for elderly family members. Everything was spotless, comfortable, and well prepared. Beds and furniture were great, linens were plentiful, and the kitchen had all essential cookware, making it easy to feel at home.
What made the place special was its character. It has a beautiful Turkish artistic touch that helps you connect with the culture rather than feel like just a visitor.
Zeynep was an exceptional host, kind, responsive, and incredibly helpful. She shared detailed info on transportation, places to visit, and where to eat, and even met us on arrival.
After staying in multiple Airbnbs in Istanbul, this one truly stands out.
Thank you, Zeynep!

First and foremost, the communication with Zeynep was great. She was prompt in responding to my inquiries and provided all the necessary information and details, from check-in procedure to recommendations and advices about the city. Furthermore, on the day of our departure, she was kind enough to book the cab for us to the airport.
Regarding the apartment itself, it was spacious, clean, and very well-equipped. It’s worth mentioning that the shared terrace was really cool with an outstanding view of the city.
Lastly, I cannot fail to mention the prime location of the property. It was conveniently situated in a vibrant neighborhood, within walking distance of Taksim square, Istiklal avenue, and the public transportation, although if you want to reach the apartment by tram, expect an uphill/stair walk, but for the subway (Taksim) is fine.
Overall, I would say this is a great property for anyone seeking a comfortable stay in Istanbul.

description:
WELCOME to our 3 Bedrooms +1 living room villa (125 Sq.meters with 2 Kingsize beds & 4 single beds, 1 Sofa bed, can comfortably accommodate 9 people).

All family necessities are ready for our guests.

This is a three storey detached building. stairs are inside. remember you have to climb stairs to reach out the bedrooms.

OUR central location is within walking distance of Istanbul's most popular historical, cultural and tourist attractions. Tramvay station is in walking distance.

reviews.text:
The good things:
•AC through out the house (which is hard to find in Turkey)
•8min walk to Blue Mosque, Hippodrome, Sophia Mosque/restaurants/grocery stores/currency exchange/trams
•Ramazan is near by and is very helpful and kind (he's an employee of the host), he gave me a tour of the area, showed me where the grocery store is, good places to eat, pharmacy, etc
•Muhammad arranged airport pickup which I highly recommend doing (it is a 1.5hr drive to the house from IST)
•Wifi works really well
•Verizon will have service here if you have the TravelPass
•House is clean
•The shower head in the upstairs bathroom was broken, I told Muhammad and he sent Ramazan to fix it within 15min. of me messaging him
•You can contact Ramazan easily if you need anything
•The house can comfortably fit 7 adults
•There is a washing machine, stove top, plenty of plates, cups, utensils, a microwave, kettle, dishwasher, and big fridge and freezer
•There are two full size bathrooms
The inaccuracies/things to improve on:
•There is no separate dinning room which it says in the add it has, the living area has a dinning table and grey stools to sit on, but you would not be able to fit 9 people around the table.
•There is no oven or toaster, just something to note
•There is no dryer, so after you wash your clothes you have to hang them up outside on a clothes rack, or hang the clothes around the house to dry. There is a small laundromat with a dryer, so if you have a large family I'd recommend washing your clothes there
•The stove top is gas, but there are no carbon monoxide monitors in the house, I recommend that the host purchase some for the home for added safety.
•The add says there are no stairs, but there is a big winding stair case (with no handrails) that leads up to the 2nd-3rd floors with the bedrooms on them. I fell down the steps coming from the 3rd floor; there is one step taller than the rest, just a warning to those coming down from the 3rd floor
•The add states there are extra pillows/blankets, but I could not find any. Each bed has 1 blanket and 1-2 pillows, I recommend the host place some extra blankets in the wardrobes in each room for added comfort for guests
•The add states there are two king size beds, but there is 1 full size and 1 king size bed on the 2nd floor. There are 3 twin beds on the 3rd floor. And the couch on the ground floor can convert into a bed
•There are not many towels and no hooks in the bathrooms to hang the towels up to dry once you've used them, I suggest the host add some hooks to the backs of the bathroom doors and leave some more towels for the guests
•The bathrooms are small, If you have multiple guests, you will need to keep your toiletries in your suit case, I feel like the bathroom size is a cultural aspect of Istanbul, but it's something to note if you're a bigger/taller person as well.
You have to take into account the culture of the area as well. The house is amazing for this area of Istanbul, but there are things certain people may be accustomed to that are very different here in Turkey. I would recommend staying here to someone I know and I would stay here again. The things mentioned above are just my interpretation of what I experienced and are NOT bad things, just things to note.
Thank you for a great stay, Muhammad and Ramazan!!
I hope my review helps future guests!

I stayed in this location for 6 days. Reserved for 9 people but ended up with 7 since 2 people couldn't show up. 3 story apartment, 3rd floor: 1 queen bed and a single bed (2 room with same entrance), 2nd floor 2 bed with queen and king size beds with a full washroom and the first floor with one bedroom/living room with a pull -out coach for 2 people, full bath and a kitchen. All rooms have AC and heater and they all worked. Kitchen had plenty of utensil. Stairs are steep but they have rails for the safety.
The location is great, close to mosques, tram, grand bazaar and boat tours. Also plenty of grocery/restaurants available nearby, heavy traffic area though.
Mohammad (co host) was responsive and friendly (thank you Mohammad), he arranged a van for us to airport.
To improve: 2nd floor batch had a broken shower holder and had to hold the shower in your hand.
The key was delivered by host's friend and he only showed how to use the key, the brief tour of the place would've been great.

Hi,
I start with the positives first as Muhammed was very responsive to our requests.
Location was excellent in terms if being close to most of the sightseeings; however, I should mind everyone that this area in general is very expensive compare to somewhere less central.
If you have children, don’t choose this property. First, the pictures do not show the steep, sharp steps to the bedrooms. nor does any information on the noise from the mosques five times a day and at early hours of morning- the “Azan : calling”- our toddlers used to be woken up by the mosques calling two to three times a night.
Besides, the furniture is very old and the lounge is too small. Smaller than what you see in the photos.
The host was very lovely and responsive, but I really didn’t like this property and it didn’t worth a £100 a night at all.

From the outset, Faysal's responsiveness and attentiveness to our needs set the tone for a fantastic stay.
This unit we have booked was clean and had a nice location to the Grand Bazaar BUT open checking in, we only found out there were stairs leading to 3 levels of bedrooms and it wasn’t so convenient for my parents and mother in law as they are of age and their knees were not so good. Upon realizing the initial accommodation might not suit my parents and mother-in-law due to the stairs, Faysal immediately offered us an alternative ground-floor unit. This gesture of consideration and quick problem-solving was greatly appreciated, and made our stay much more comfortable.
The alternative accommodation clean, spacious & wonderfully located, near a supermarket, delightful eating places, and a short walk from the Grand Bazaar, which we found to be exceptionally convenient. He also recommended a very knowledgeable & professional local guide who brought us around town and the bosphorus!

Wouldn’t recommend the stay the sheets had blood stains very disgusting. The hot water was coming on and off when we called him he came right away but it turned off and then off and on and off. The shower head on the main floor was broken and no one was able to shower. The towels had makeup stains. Very upset with my stay considering I paid a lot to have a good experience. These is also MANY stairs to walk to get to the bedrooms so would not recommend for elderly people or disabled people.

description:
Well..., would you like to stay unique Private Detached house with private gardens in hearth of Istanbul because you don’t get many like this house with garden & bbc area.


Remember this booking will be only ground floor to bedroom house & garden.

Air conditioning is living room.

We can accommodate 6 people at the same time.

It is suitable for disable people to stay, easy access to get in and out.

It has got Private garden and also veranda to have tea coffee even bbq.

reviews.text:
Everything was great!!!
Nice house and friendly host, we stay with our dog. Pet friendly place, nice garden to walk with dog
Thank you! We are pleased the staying here

Ev aile ortamina cok cok uygun ve cocuklarin bahcede oynayabilecegi harika konumda.
Temiz ve hemen hemen her sey dusunulmus.
Şehrin merkezinde müstakil bir yapı market ve çarşı çok yakın yanında parkı bulunan müthiş bir yer. Özellikle ev sahibi çok ilgili ve kibar. Her şey için çok teşekkür ederiz.

The house is amazing. It’s near from bus stop, marmaray station. There are a lot of shops and markets around the house area. Ilhan answers very fast and helps with everything. I really suggest to stay in this house and enjoy Istanbul.

Good location for anatolian side of Istanbul. So close to everywhere where you need.House was so cool you can find everything in there what you need in a house . Mr. Ilhan had always connection with us and solved what we need. Thanks for everything.

description:
The place is a one-room studio apartment with a bathroom and fully equipped small kitchen.Double bed with a good enough space. Including a bathroom and a kitchenette which are fully equipped. "dry cleaning" is with extra fee, i am geting your clothes, i am washing, after i make iron, i am giving your clothes back same day or the next day.
The cleaning will be done everyday by our staff free of chage.Besides, the wi-fi are free of charge!

reviews.text: The location is accurate. It had everything I needed for one night like private clean bath, small kitchen with hot water heater, air conditioning, nice clean king bed. It was very noisy throughout the night (until about 4am then the business day started about an hour later) including a guy walking and playing drums, keep this in mind if you need sleep or have small children. The host was very nice and communicated very well leading up to my stay and while there. I took the Havatus bus from the airport then walked less than 10min to the Cartoon Hotel where Oytun walked to pick me up. Very nice guy!

our host Oytun was great, he allowed us to check in early which was a great advantage after our 12 hour overnight bus. The room was clean and tidy exactly as described, the location was perfect 2 minutes from Taksim. the breakfast was delicious. This was a great place to stay the bed was comfortable the wifi was fast. thank you.

Location! Location! Location! You can’t ask for more...it’s less than 5 mins to Taksim Square... in a quiet neighborhood with many supermarket nearby and local restaurant that you can get good meal for half the price from Taksim/ Istiklal street (touristic part of the city). The staff are amazingly friendly and helpful which makes you feel like home. The room is comfortable, bright and clean. WiFi was good but sometimes it was weak. Breakfast menu needs variation especially for people like me who stayed for weeks. The street is safe and I will definitely be back here when I’m in Istanbul (which is about a week from now...looking forward to staying here again. Thanks Oytun/ Egemen and all for the hospitality!

Place is in a bad neighborhood. Not necessarily unsafe, but a neighborhood that has fallen on hard times. It’s just a hotel. Not air bnb. Looked much better in the photos. I use the internet for booking a few months out of the year and feel my expectations are within reason. Close to Taksim square and clean. I forfeited my stay and found a great boutique hotel in a great neighborhood in Galata for less. It’s not a bad place at all - just overpriced and located poorly for a tourist. Sorry!

The hotel is cozy, has an elevator. Room on the picture looks a little more, but on the whole there is enough space. Cleaning done every day. Repair is not new, but good, nothing annoying. Breakfast - buffet. Every day is the same food, you can eat well). If you ask the hostess kitchen, she can make you hot omelet. On the last day before our Departure settled noisy neighbors. We asked the administrator to calm them, in the next room quickly silenced (we were told that on the weekends it happens). Thank you for your hospitality.

description: Located in Sultanahmet, our 3-bedroom duplex apartment is just walking distance from unique historical sites like Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, and the Basilica Cistern. Located approximately 300 meters from the Çemberlitaş tram station and just 400 meters from the Grand Bazaar, it offers easy access to all the historical and cultural treasures of Istanbul's heart. Its central location offers a comfortable and unforgettable stay.

reviews.text:
We have expected a more comfortable place from seeing the pics online.
The apartment is very old. The living space upstairs has cigarette smell, and downstairs where bedrooms are it has musty smell. Be prepared to see very outdated fixtures, appliances and furniture, it may be 30-40 years old or even older.
If you think of cooking there, it might be difficult as the kitchen is not equipped with all the necessary utensils. We were missing tea spoons, tea towels, there was one dull knife, no cutting board. Kitchen cabinets were greasy; we didn’t even try dishwasher because it looked so old that we were afraid to use it.
Upstairs there were two airconditioners, one wasn’t cooling well.
The bedrooms are in basement with windows looking on the small busy street. There was no a/c downstairs, and you can’t have windows open because of noise - cars parking in front of the windows, screaming cats, seagulls cries; at around 4:30 am you might be awaken from prayer calls, which you might find charming. Bedrooms were small with the bear minimum bedding - old uncomfortable pillows, cotton throws instead of blankets, the mattresses were dirty. Cheap furniture, some broken. For 6 people there were provided three small towels. No large towels were provided, but were on request. Bathroom is functional, but again very old - flimsy toilet seat, the bathtub is under the staircase and hard to use for tall people, there was no bath mat provided, so be careful as not to fall; no hand soap was provided.
The best part is the location - 10 min walk to Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia. You can find lots of charming hotels in that area, with better conditions and at a lower price.
Host Emir was very accommodating, responds quickly on messages, also he works across the street therefore it’s quick and easy to communicate any issues, but his English isn’t great, therefore miscommunications happen.

This Airbnb was comfortable and in a good location, with an affordable price. It worked well for our group of friends. Beds were comfortable, with ample bedding and extra pillows provided in one room. One friend did report she could feel the springs in the mattress in the bunk bed room, though. The bathroom with shower is a bit small, and the bathroom floor gets soaked during showers. Kitchen's nice.
The hosts were as flexible as they could be with check in and check-out, which we appreciated. On check-out, they allowed us to leave our luggage in the apartment while it was being cleaned so that we didn't have heavy to spend the day with it before our flight. Check-in was mildly annoying, as the apartment was supposed to be ready by 2pm but ended up being ready slightly after.
After check-out the host messaged me requesting a 5 star review. This is my honest review, not influencedb by that request. Reviews should be honest. This airbnb is good, but not exceptional.

We had a wonderful time at Hakki's apartment. The place is totally worth the price. The location is good - if you survive around the crazy Istanbul taxi drivers you're on minutes distance from St Sophia and the Blue Mosque. There are local shops and nice restaurants nearby. I do not recommend the bakery at the end of the street however - too expensive in my opinion. Hakki and Emir were most welcoming - they had to wait us hours after the check in time because of jams but were still polite and even spared a parking place for us in the street. We had an issue with the hot water, which was quickly resolved but as an advice - check the hot water when you check in so they can react timely. The interior and the furniture are good for the price. We were comfortable and happy. Thank you guys!

so unfortunately the description is NOT accurate. Self checkin: false. the house does not have a keypad nor dropbox and the owner needs to check you in. Accuracy: the photos are highly filtered. The house was not clean, the shower is badly maintained and had mold. There was too much carpet in the house which they did not vacuum for a while, so the house felt very dusty. There are religious riot photos in the bedroom which as a tourist I find highly inappropriate. Overall I found this had more of a low lowest end hostel feel. Not what the listing represent. I do not think the other reviews are from actual guests, they seem fake. The only positive thing is the location as it's walking distance to all hotspots. The reason we didn't cancel is because we only spend 1 night. If it was longer we would have asked a full refund! I would NOT stay here again though and NOT recommend.

Great location and nice host but the rooms were dirty. Stains and hair on the beds, there was dust and dirt in some areas. Worst part is the hot water wasn’t working the first night and had to take an ice shower. Host came and fixed it the next day and showed me how to fix it which I had to do every hour or so when using the water. Some weird water heater system they have where you need to drain water manually to have the water heater work. Wasn’t the best stay for the price. Wouldn’t come back to this apartment.

description: Stay in the heart of Beyoğlu, just steps from Istiklal Avenue, Galata Tower, and Pera Museum. Enjoy a stylish, well-appointed room with plush bedding, air conditioning, floor heating, and a modern en-suite bathroom. Perfect for sightseers, digital nomads, and business travelers, our location offers easy access to top attractions, dining, and nightlife. Experience comfort and convenience in vibrant Istanbul!

reviews.text:
Everything was exactly like in the pictures. The bed very comfortable, the heating floor was a cool asset of the room.
Our host Mustafa and his colleagues were very friendly and helpful.
The location of the place is amaizing, accessible by walking to all the nice places around.
Overall was a great staying. Highly recommended!
