A very clean, neat and tidy hotel room! It's exactly as the pictures show it to be. A couple of minutes walk from Istiklal Street. Hotel is located on a smaller street so it's really quiet, unlike most other hotels in Taksim.
Mustafa was an amazing host. He arranged transport to and from the airport. He also scheduled our Covid tests, which were done at the hotel itself. We didn't have to worry about any of that stuff and were able to focus on enjoying our trip!
All in all, an excellent place to stay!

The only thing that could be better is the Shower cabin, although it was very clean inside, the Doors had some mold stains on the rails.
Apart from that Detail, we got greeted by Sophia, who was extremely friendly and helpful. He showed us our room and was asking us daily If we needed anything. A daily cleaning Service could be used by just pressing a button on their Apartment system.
Not only would I recommend the place, I would also rebook it on my next visit.
All in all, great Location, great Hosts, very nice price-quality Ratio.

Mustafa is one of the most amazing hosts I ve ever met, he’s very nice and helpful. I booked for my parents at Mustafa’s hotel and he took a really good care of them. The place was clean and cosy, the location perfect and the room looked exactly like the pictures. Definitely recommend it. Thank for everything my friend see you soon.

Mustafa and Paulina were excellent hosts!! Made us feel right at home, provided us with information about local transportation, attractions, and food recommendations. Also ordered us a taxi back to the airport for a great price, better than Uber and local taxi service. Room was clean and fresh, washroom was modern and spotless. Water bottles, coffee, towels, soap, shampoo complimentary. Fresh linens. Next time I’ll be sure to contact Mustafa directly instead of using the app. These guys deserve your business!!! Less than 5 min walk to TAKSIM Square!!

description:
Im renting one single private room of my house that i currently living in.Single private room has double size bed, wardrobe, desk for study and sitting place.The house is in the center of Balat and 3 min distance to all means of transport. 15 min distance to Taksim.Shared kitchen is fully equipment (coffe machine, toast machine, oven, kettle, etc) and available for use.

Im also certified Thai Massage therapist, if you interested in you can buy one healing massage session from me ("only female")

reviews.text:
Everything is accurate as described. The only factor which could also be added is the house being on a hill, which could be a bit of hike for someone not used to it.
Check-in:
From Istanbul airport, I took HAVIST-16 direct bus to Takseem Square. The ticket cost was 67TL or $5CAD. Afterwards, it took me a 45 minutes walk/ferry to reach the room from Takseem Square.
Alternatively, I could have taken bus#55T from Takseem Square, which would have dropped at Fener station which is a five minute walk from the house. On my way back to airport, I too this bus and it was a 17 minute ride to Takseem Square, and then took HAVIST-16 to reach Istanbul Airport. This route was recommended by the host as being the most direct.
The neighborhood has good restaurants, which are cheaper than those at Sultanahmet.
Overall, a good place for a short stay for those who are on a budget.
I would recommend.

Görkem was a very nice host to us. She will be helpful if you need any advise. The place is like shown in the pictures. Shared small kitchen and bathroom and a private bedroom. Simple as in the picture. Really near by of Balat and nice places around to eat and do a bit of turism.
Thank you

The apartment matches the description BUT in my opinion it wasn't clean enough. I don't mind about the whole apartment, but I think the room should be cleaner and the host have to clean after previous guest. Plus, the worse thing was that I felt like the host didn't change the sheets because I found hair and eyelashes in my bed and I had to sleep in this bed about three nights because she didn't have clean sheets and it took about three days to give me a new one. In other things she was nice host, she met me on the bus stop, explained how to get to her apartment and I don't have any complaints about her as a person.

this is stay number 3 for me gorkem sooo kind host she alwayes support she alwayes try to produce any thing for make your stay comfortable the room very clean very quite the apart very clean really thank you sooo much
I like this place, the location isgood and there are a lots of restaurant near it. Also bus station accessible. And my the hostess was quaint and kind

description:
My Apartment is centrally located in oldtown, just 5 min. walk to Sultanahmet Square & Hippodrome also historic attractions.

Duru Sultanahmet Apart & Suites: our apart hotel, your home.
If comfort and hygiene is your red line, then Duru Sultanahmet is your place to stay. Our name Duru, stands for pure and clear in Turkish, and we chose our name for a reason. In these times, where hygiene is more important than ever, our mission is to provide its guests a comfortable and safe place so stay.

reviews.text:
Errands was very responsive and helpful. He was excellent at how quickly he retuned messages. The whole place was non smoking!
The space is small, very tight in bedroom area and no where to relax except the bed.
The apartment was clean and tidy, however there were several things that could use upgrading. The mattress was extremely hard with a thin rubber sheet for the mattress pad. It could use a 2’ latex topper. The comforter did not drape over the bed at all and when under the covers, your sides felt drafts. Luckily we has some small blankets. There were no extras. There was no toaster. But by far, the very biggest problem was the noise. The garbage truck comes 5 times a day. Seriously, the rubbish for the whole neighborhood is 40’ from the building. The last pickup is !1:30 at night. You can not control the heat very well inside the space( central heating) we had to open windows and then of course there was noise. The people walking on the streets voices carried right inside.

The apartment was on the second floor and there are stairs to account for when you have a lot of luggage like we did but the host helped us with our luggage. The place is a bit smaller than it looks like in the photos. The views outside the window are splendid. The place is also walking distance to all the main attractions in Sultanahmet. The host also gave a lot of good recommendations and helped arrange the Princes’ Islands tour and the airport transfer for us.

This is a fantastic Airbnb. The host was so very communicative via WhatsApp, the apartment was just as advertised: clean, wonderful view, amazing location, easy check-in. We particularly liked the king size bed and large open shower. Ercan also set us up with a private walking tour of the Sultanahmed area including all the historical sites and a few off-the-beaten path locations. Our short stay in Istanbul was truly life-changing and we are already talking about our next visit. Thank you Ercan for welcoming us to your beautiful city which we've named "the center of the world". We can't wait to return. Ercan'a teşekkür ederim.
Great location. Short walk to main attractions and transport. The apartment had everything we needed. It was clean and comfortable. The host communicated well and assisted me with what I needed.
Very happy with Ercan’s place. The room was clean, liked the area, literally 5 minutes by walk from the blue mosque , check-in and out was fast and comfortable. Recommended

description:
My Apartment is centrally located in oldtown, just 5 min. walk to Sultanahmet Square & Hippodrome also historic attractions.

Duru Sultanahmet Apart & Suites: our apart hotel, your home.
If comfort and hygiene is your red line, then Duru Sultanahmet is your place to stay. Our name Duru, stands for pure and clear in Turkish, and we chose our name for a reason. In these times, where hygiene is more important than ever, our mission is to provide its guests a comfortable and safe place so stay.

reviews.text: Great place to stay. The description and photos were all true. Blue mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, and a tram stop are all within a 10 minute walk. There are multiple restaurants a 1/2 block away. The apartment has a comfortable king bed, the bathroom is very adequate with great water pressure. The only very minor con is the outside street noise at night but cheap ear plugs provide adequate protection. Our host provided great recommendations, arranged transport to/from the airport and handled getting our laundry done for a small fee.

We had a comfortable stay at Ercans place. Easy walking distance to the sultanhemet square and the tram passing many restaurants and shops. Easy check in process. We didn’t use any of the kitchen appliances so can’t offer any comments there. Bed was comfortable and there is cleaning service if required. Thanks for a comfortable stay!

Our 4 night stay at this Airbnb was great! The place is super clean, in a perfect location, and we had a contact that was reachable through messaging anytime. The wifi in the room works perfectly. This was a perfect location with a 5 minute walk to Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. There’s restaurants open past midnight on the same street as the Airbnb which is convenient, however they were pricey. The only negative point about this room for us was that since it’s an apartment style, you could hear your next door neighbours. Other than that it was a pleasant and comfortable stay!

Ercan’s place was awesome. The location and size was as described, and the apartment was clean and comfortable. Ercan was also a great host and helped me promptly when I lost my key. Overall 9/10 stay.

Great location near to the Blue Mosque and located in a vibrant restaurant area. Ercan was a great host and was always happy to help. Loved seeing Ercan's own amazing photos around the place too which added a personal touch. Apartment was clean and the perfect size for the 2 of us.

description:
Our apartment in the Şişli area is a residence concept apartment in a smart and young building, furnished with new and modern furniture, air-conditioned, with double TV, washing and drying machine, parking lot, in a perfect location, with security, and will offer you home comfort for your short and long-term stays.
Florence Nightingale Hospital 10 m.
900 m to Cevahir Shopping Mall.
Trump Towers Shopping Mall 950 m.
Bilgi University 850 m.
Turkey Hospital 1.5 km

reviews.text:
Ismail is a very nice and responsive host, we were even able to check in earlier.
The apartment is located in Kagithane, near the Trump Tower. Its located very strategic, near to Sisli, Fatih, Beyoglu, Besiktas en Uskudar. Uskudar is a very nice to be, you can go by a ferry or car.
The apartment is new and very clean, it has 2 bedrooms and 2 sofa beds in the livingroom with many windows. There is floor heating and its not controlled by the apartment. So during winter you wont be cold at all!
We were with five people and we needed a lot of space. The apartment was provided with many closets and a washing machine and a dryer. We even had a dishwasher for our convenient.
The Bathroom is just good, not to big not to small, enough for average size people. The bin is collected every day a 11 am and 17 pm, so you don't need to go downstairs to throw the bin yourself. How convenient is that?!
Again the area where the apartment is very strategic. The metro is walking distance, you have a big hospital around the corner, for any PCR tests. However at this area Istanbul, you can rent a car, because there is more space to put the car. But we did not choose the rent a car, because the heavy traffic. So we really do recommend this place, this apartment and our host Ismail. Not to forget the staff at the entrance, who are 24/7 downstairs and protecting our safety!

The apartment is new and in a nice building with a great view, but it has many problems. The kitchen was very dirty when we arrived, with no cleaning done. There wasn't even a bottle of water, and we arrived late at night with nothing to drink. There were no tissues, shampoo, or soap. The host didn't provide anything, and the cleaning was poor. The next day, they sent someone to clean the kitchen and brought a few things we requested. The shower was broken and leaking, so the bathroom floor was always wet after we used it. The house maintenance is poor. The location is close to the metro station, but you need to change lines to reach the main neighborhoods in Istanbul. Ismail, the host, was very unfriendly and unhelpful. He spoke rudely to us on the phone.

7 gün boyunca bu dairede konakladık ve gerçekten çok memnun kaldık. Daire son derece temiz ve fiyatına göre sunduğu imkanlar gerçekten çok iyiydi. İki yatak odası ve bir salon olması bizim için çok rahattı. Ayrıca çamaşır makinesi ve kurutma makinesini çok kullandık ve bizim için büyük bir kolaylık oldu.
Resepsiyonda çalışan Abdülbasit Bey çok nazik, yardımsever ve ilgiliydi. Ayrıca giriş saatimizden daha erken daireye girebilmemize yardımcı oldular. Bu bizim için özellikle çok önemliydi ve uzun bir yolculuktan sonra bizi gerçekten çok rahatlattı.
Daire 14. kattaydı ve balkondan manzara gerçekten harikaydı. Mutfakta ihtiyacımız olan tüm eşyalar mevcuttu. Sıcak su sistemi, internet ve diğer tüm imkanlar sorunsuz çalışıyordu.
Genel olarak daireden ve aldığımız hizmetten çok memnun kaldık. Kesinlikle tekrar burada kalırız ve hiç düşünmeden yeniden tercih ederiz. Her şey için çok teşekkür ederiz!

The stay was good but 2, 3 notable things:
1 The receptionist was not cleary instructed for our arrival. We were about to reach at midnight but due to flight delay, we reached at around 2:00am. The description of the place was not accurate causing it hard to find and even when I showed the receptionist of 'Boaf' the address, he returned us, causing us to wander at 2:00 am. But this is where the apartment is actually located. We luckily found a couple and called to the same receptionist through them and then he allowed us. (There is language issue but that's understandable)
2 The kitchen utensils were dirty and sticky and the Electric Kettle was not working though it was replaced on request.
3 No cooking essential was provided like salt, chilli etc. These small things make a big difference.
It seems thorough check of the apartment was not done before checkin.

Ismail was a great host, he was very flexible with my situation and his unit was clean and relaxing close to metro (if you like to use public transportation). This place comes with 24/7 receptions which can help you if you need something and feels safe. I managed to talk to them via google translate. They also take your garbage every morning. Overall great value I would say that i was really satisfied with my stay there.

description: Welcome to VNG Property's brand new modern high ceiling loft duplex in the heart of prime Nisantasi with views of the bosphorus! 2 bedroom/2 bathroom, w/ walk in closet! Close to all the tastiest restaurants and cafes and all the fanciest trendiest shops! Situated on the fourth floor w/ elevator and is walking distance to all transportation links. The perfect home away from home! We invite you to come stay with us! Comes w/ Wifi, Netflix, all new white appliances and a fully fitted kitchen!

reviews.text: Nisantasi is my new favorite location! The flat was nice in size, 2 bed 2 bathroom, both were well air conditioned and clean. Kitchen is small but perfect for light meals and breakfast. The living area and dining kitchen areas are fully open and very bright and comfortable. Netflix was working which is nice for relaxing. I was staying post operative and the upstairs room was so cool and nice for convalescence although stairs are fairly steep. There is a bed and bath downstairs as well if someone wants to avoid stairs altogether. For anyone impaired, this is one of the lowest stair counts I have seen in Istanbul. And being on top of the hill means you can shop the area without the rigor of hills. It was good for me since I had surgery. Taxis are plentiful and most using meters. This is rare in most other tourist areas. It was a home base for Istanbul!! And OH the skylights upstairs that open mean fresh air up there too! I would definitely stay again. Probably the best value I have seen!

We absolutely loved our stay at this beautiful loft. (We rented 2 lofts on the same floor for a family reunion). We had some elderly guests with us so it was a plus to be able to stay at the top floor of this elevator operated building (which is hard to find in Istanbul ). The apartment is very beautiful, clean and spacious. The view is also gorgeous. The VNG team were super responsive and helpful. We asked for extra towels which were promptly provided. We also requested for early check in and late checkout which they granted us and we were super grateful for. There is a neighbourhood convenience store right outside the building where we bought all the essentials we needed. I LOVED the location. It’s in a quiet yet very central spot in Nisantasi, walking distance to all the shopping and restaurants. Highly recommend this place and would stay here again in a heartbeat

This is definitely one of the best and cleanest Airbnb’s I’ve ever stayed in! Everything is super modern and the apartment was spotless! The AC worked very well and the comforters on the bed were super comfortable. Showers had great water pressure and having the washing machine was super convenient for us. The location is also great- quiet and in the classy neighborhood of Nişantaşı in İstanbul. I wish we could’ve stayed longer, thanks so much!

Very nice, spacious, and comfortable apartment in a great location (not on a main street so limited traffic noise). The VNG team is very responsive and supportive when needed.
Internet was a bit slow but still manageable.
Will definitely consider staying here again.

We have used VNG property already 4 months ago and returned to the same location and building, because we knew exactly what expected us. So this made it a seamless experience for us.
Apartments are always spotless clean, well furnitured, bathrooms and showers that are fully upgraded and renovated.
Our next Istanbul visit will be again with VNG Property as they really stand out.

description: You will both have a comfortable stay in this brand new place located in a residence with 24-hour security in a central location and enjoy Istanbul and easily access everywhere.

reviews.text:
Elegant, large (3-bedroom) and comfortable apartment with a fabulous living room and two bathrooms. The bedrooms are cosy, the beds are comfortable and the pictures on the walls are lovely! The bathrooms are clean with nice attention to details. In fact all the furniture is modern and stylish.
The kitchen is clean and neat, and has all the necessary equipment: an induction cooker, an electro grill, a kettle, a coffee maker and even a dishwasher! Little touches (like bottled water and cleaning materials) made our stay pleasant and comfortable.
The location is quite convenient and in close proximity to the bus, tram and metrobus stops; small shops nearby offer a variety of fruit and vegetables, cheeses, olives etc. as well as fresh Turkish pastry and bakery.
The owner is very friendly and helpful; we are very much grateful to her for such an amazing stay. We would love to come back again and would definitely recommend this place to others!

15-19 Mayıs tarihlerinde iki aile 4 gece olarak konaklama yaptık.Öncelikle iletişim konusundaki tutumu hızlı dönüş sağlaması ve güven verici konuşmaları için Nilüfer hanıma çok teşekkür ediyorum.Konum olarak hemen metrobüs durağında ve tramvay durağına aktarma yapmak çok rahat.İstanbul gibi bir yer için en fazla yarım saatte her noktaya rahatça ulaşabilirsiniz.Evde sizin için gerekli tüm malzeme ve eşyalar mevcut.Temizlik konusunda hiç sıkıntı yok.Otopark olması büyük bir artı.Araçları ile gelecek aileler için büyük rahatlık.Kısacası biz konaklamamızdan ulaşım,ev sahibi ile iletişim,temizlik,ev eşyaları konusunda çok memnun kaldık.Gönül rahatlığı ile kalabilirsiniz.

We had a great time at Nilufer's apartment, she is a great host! The place was clean and had everything we needed it (a kitchen chopper would be useful :))). Many shops and place to eat nearby the apartment.
Easy access to the bus/metrobus (it takes 30-40 minutes to the historical center). The parking spot was so useful! It's difficult to find parking places around the building/ in Istanbul.

We had a great time at Nilufer’s place. The apartment was very clean and the furniture were very comfortable. The place also had all the amenities we needed. We found the location of the apartment practical, reletively close to many touristy and shopping attractions but not directly in high trafic areas. The public transit access was very good, there is a metrobus stop nearby and many bus stops in the neighborhood. Also there is a taxi station right next to the metrobus stop.
There were an issue with the lighting in the bathroom and Nilufer was very responsive and quick to send someoneyy to come and resolve the issue.
Nilufer was very hospitable and friendly. We wanted to make a special dish and she brought us some extra pots for that. She also helped with other questions we had and gave very good recommendations for places in Istanbul and for our next destination in Bodrum.
In addition to all of these, before leaving for Bodrum we needed some arrangements with our luggages and she graciously helped with that as well.

I highly recommend this place. My family and I stayed at this apartment for over a month. This place is perfect for families with babies and older people and for extended stays. There is literally no stairs so it's very accessible for kids and elderly. There are so many stores around. You can easily walk to supermarkets, butcher shops, pharmacies, resturants, coffeeshops, bakeries, and etc.
There are bus staitions just 5 minutes away. You can easily use the public transportation to the different neighborhoods.
The host, Nilufer, is awesome. She is super friendly, going above and beyond to make your stay enjoyable. She helped us a lot with whatever we needed. She provided baby crib and bought a baby bath tub per our request. She advised us not to use the tap water. When I had issue with ordering water with my credit card, Nilufer, ordered water for us every few days. I really appreciated her help.
The apartment had almost everything we needed for our extended stay. Very satisfied.

description:
....More than a home....

This is a quiet, warm, clean, modern apartment that will give you the space to breathe and relax with that comfy feeling that only a home can provide.Just walking distance from public transportation ( bus stops, metrobus and etc) You’ll find a great variety of restaurants, cafes, and shops near by your home.

Fully Luxury Furnished
Fully Equipped Kitchen and Bathrooms
Free WIFI
Free Indoor Parking
Netflix
and more much more....

reviews.text:
I don’t know where to start from, from start to bottom this place is incredible. The host himself Yildrim was very helpful always just one message away. The property was clean fully equipped. He had cleaning products ready if you have OCD like me :D
There’s a metro station just near the apartment which we didn’t use but I do recommend having a Uber app as although there is a taksi station right next to the apartment due to Istanbul being very busy sometimes is hard to get a taksi, there was times we couldn’t get a taksi but never waited more 10 minutes. There’s a dentist, plenty hospitals and many shops and little cafes you can buy food from. The location is very good only 15 minutes on taksi to most places central Istanbul which doesn’t cost no more than 80Tl which is roughly £4 to £6 pounds. Overall this place is worth every penny and I would definitely go again.
Thank you Yildirim for everything

The apartment is new, clean and comfortable. The location is great and close to many attractions. The host is very accommodating and helpful. Check in & out is easy. It was a great stay for us and will visit again.

A really spacious apartment and very comfortable! It is really convenient for Memorial Hospital visits, highly recommend! Parking is indoor and safe. Very clean apartment and has everything you need. There are lots of shops nearby, fresh produce, fast food and even beer.

Everything as described. Very fast replies. Nice big apartment. Nice neighborhood with lots of groceries. Perfect place if you’re staying for treatment at Memorial Şişli. Maybe just one thing that was missing personally for me is a drip coffee maker. It would be a nice addition in the future. Other than that everything was perfect!

Good flat not far from the city center (europian part). Has a convenient transport connection and all needed amenities around.
You will have all you need during your stay: comfortable fully furnished place with all staff needed for living even for a long period of time, new building and nice neighbors on a floor.
Couple things are still need to be finished cause the appartement is new, but hope when you read it everything is aready perfect :)

description:
Wi-fi internet.Located in the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museum, theater, concert halls and movie theaters located at Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul, awaits to welcome its new residents. Walking distance to places such as Nisantaşı, Taksim and Cihangir.

Have elevator and garage. New and high quality furniture. Good for couples. Have a city view, please check photos for details.in.

reviews.text:
L’appartement est exactement comme sur les photos, très jolis.
Nous avons demander un lit bébé que nous avons eu.
Le système d’ouverture pour la porte ce fait via une application (je ne connaissais pas ce système et je ne le trouve pas très pratique, prévoir d’avoir de la batterie et internet).
Pas loins de taksim en taxi mais à pied sa reste difficile à faire car il y’a une longue pente.
Nous avons eu un petit soucis de wifi à notre arrivée qui a été résolu le lendemain.
Bonne communication avec l’hôte !
Merci

The team communicating couldn’t be better. We had a small issue getting on WiFi and was resolved straight away and the cot was slightly small for our 15 month old (it was lovely if the baby was smaller) and it was replaced with a larger cot promptly.
Helped storing our luggage on the last day as well so thank you so much!
The apartment was great and the staff friendly in reception and gave our baby lots of attention! The pool facilities were a little gem, so easy to access.
I gave everything a 5/5 - the location was 4/5, not because it wasn’t easy to access places but it is a really busy main road so be careful crossing it. The locals on the other side of the street helped us over a few times with the pram, but we decided after one day to walk rather than taxi. And taksim very close by - a little hill to get up but from there really easy to get to other places and markets.
Fantastic experience though and well hosted for sure. Would highly recommend

Great place to stay! The apartment itself is very clean, new, and very comfortable. Easy instructions for picking up keys and a great location close to everything. We had a lovely stay and would highly recommend it.

Overall very good. Nicely furnished apartment, with good kitchen.
Location is close to Taksim square and istiklal street but be aware it is up a steep hill.
Downsides - Bed and Sofa were not the comfiest, felt it in my back after a few nights sleep.
Could also do with more things like toilet roll, washing liquid, bin bags etc. we had to buy our own after a couple of days.
It was an amazing place. Good location. Very central and all amenities. The host was very responsive and respectful with time, early check in and late check out.

description: In the centre of Kadikoy, close the coolest cafe and bar. I'm architect and my husband is tattoo artist. I designed Moda House for us and it was published in the best magazine in Turkey. In our house you can enjoy Istanbul with coziest and coolest way. There is a big kitchen with island bar fully equipped. The house has one bathroom and one wc.Two big bathroom one has a couch and it can be opened , if you want to use it. It is suitable for two person.The house has netflix, youtube automaticly.

reviews.text:
I had an amazing 122-day stay at Moda House, and I can't recommend it highly enough. The apartment is beautifully designed and reflects the host's architectural talent. It should be featured in the pages of Architectural Digest.
The space is even more impressive in person—spacious, stylish, and equipped with everything you need. The open kitchen and dining area made it easy to feel at home, and the cozy living space was perfect for both remote working and relaxing after exploring the vibrant Moda neighborhood in Kadiköy.
The location is unbeatable—just a short walk to some of the coolest cafes and bars in Istanbul. Despite being in such a lively area, the apartment was a peaceful oasis. Selkan's thoughtful weekly housekeeping service made my long-term stay feel effortless and comfortable. Communication with her was smooth and quick—she was always available if I had any questions. For anyone looking for a long-term stay on the Asia side of Istanbul, choose Moda House. I love it.

This apartment is like a dream for every airbnb user. In the last 7 years of travelling this experience was really the best!
It has 2 rooms (bedroom and cabinet with nice sofa) and a huge living room connected with a kitchen. You will have space for everything, special thanks for the area where I can make exercises.
The kitchen has a lot of beautiful cutlery and a dishwasher. It was a pleasure to cook there even if we didn't do it often.
The living room is so cozy and spacious so we spend most of our time there. Also there were nice household products like soap and shampoo. Every detail was special and great!
The location of the apartment is great! We used a guide of Selkan for cafes and were 100% satisfied. It was a pleasure to go out in the morning and take a tasty cup of coffee or have a breakfast in 5 minutes. Also I was running every day in the park near the sea. The promenade and the view were gorgeous. Highly recommend if you need a place for run.
I changed 4 apartment in Beyoglu and actually didn't like Istanbul before I came to live in Selkan's.
But I fell in love with this home and Moda.
Highly recommend this place!
Thank you Selkan <3

Love this apartment!
Totally renovated, very stylish and cozy, with all you need in excellent condition. There is a huge window with brilliant view and also a balcony in the bedroom to cool down in the evening or get your morning coffee.
The apartment is really quiet and see only green trees around, but you are still in Moda and a lot of restaurants and bars are very near. Also, the embankment with nice sea view is 5 minutes down the street.
Selkan was always in touch ready to help, but no help was needed, everything was perfect. Check-in and check-out were very easy and friendly.
Totally recommend this apartment and Moda to stay in Istanbul. Much better place for tourist as Galata Tower or Sultanahmet. And you for sure with like stay in this nice house.

Selkan’s place is pretty neat! Nicely designed, her living room gets wonderful afternoon lights and big windows really make the place grandiose. Communication with her was pretty seamless and the location of the appartement is fantastic. Be mindful, it’s on a main street so you’d hear some city noises during nighttime.

Selkan’s place is so comfortable and extremely well-designed. The pictures actually do not do the place justice; you have to see it to believe it!
I would absolutely stay again next time I am in Istanbul

description: Located just a 3-minute walk from vibrant Taksim Square, our palace-style 3-bedroom apartment offers a spacious balcony and 4 air conditioners for your comfort. Fully equipped and luxuriously decorated, it provides a relaxing atmosphere with all the amenities you need. Our building has 24-hour security to ensure your safety. Perfect for families or groups wanting to stay in the heart of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
The apartment is strategically located near taksim area. Only 5-7mins walk to taksim station and airport bus terminal (both SAW and IST busses). The apartment is well decorated and pretty spacious. There were a little issues with wifi and water but were not big of a deal as they were always solved quickly.
What’s more important is the host’s responsiveness to messages. He always responded quickly and gave us what we needed like new clean towels, extra kitchen appliances, etc. All in all very recommended!! I
Tevfik was a great host, always accessible and ready to help. The location was also perfect, walking distance to taksim square and any form of transportation. We loved our stay!

Good location for people who like to walk around areas like Taksim, Galata Port .. etc.
Its price was good & it matched the description

Very nice host, Mostafa is so friendly and helpful, he was answering us any time for help.
So near to many places by walking to avoid traffic.
Thank you. Recommended

It is a very good and beautiful apartment for 6 people near the historical part of Istanbul. And it is really good place to get to from the New Istanbul airport – bus stop "Taxim" is in 5 min from the place. The host is always ready to help you with your baggage or other.
So, it is really nice place to stay in Istanbul.

description: Our apartment is spacious, comfortable and luxuriously designed. There are easy transportation options to all parts of the city. You can stay in a historical building and enjoy the sea view.

reviews.text:
We've been in Istanbul for a few days and decided to stay in Okan's apartment. It was a very nice, clean, and cozy suit. Everything needed for visiting was provided: towels, soap, shampoo, linen, etc. Everything was clean and fresh. There is a big TV which you can pair with your Youtube, Netflix, or Amazon Video app on the phone and watch entertainment from your account. We were living in suits with a view of the stadium and the Bosphorus Strait and stadium, so we watched the football match, Turkey vs. Georgia for free. (Turkey won 1:0)
If you arrive by car, you can park it in the backyard, but ask for the exact location on the map because it's different from the location of the address. Okan met us and showed us the road to a parking spot. I appreciate it because it's a challenge to find a parking lot in Istanbul, especially on the narrow streets.
We liked Okan's suites and recommended it for staying.
Thank you, Okan, Bedrihan, and Nuraim, for your kind and warm greetings and hosting! You work hard to provide the service with an excellent quality

Overall Stay: Positive
The apartment is great for a week-long stay in Istanbul. It offers a stunning view from the window, an excellent location, and is both clean and modern.
However, there are a few minor issues:
• The shower mixer occasionally malfunctions, but hot water is available.
• The apartment has poor ventilation, so you’ll need to open windows for proper airflow, as it can get stuffy at times.
• Some concierge staff do not speak English, which caused a few communication challenges.
That said, these are small inconveniences, and the apartment remains a wonderful place to stay overall. Highly recommended!

The place was as described in the advertisement, it was clean, conveniently located near many attractions, reception, stuff, work, great and helpful, especially Mateen, if who went out of his way to provide outstanding service, including offering to get me medicine and home remedies when he noticed that I was a little sick. Overall, it was a very pleasant experience and I would go there again, anytime!

We had a wonderful stay at Okan's place in Istanbul! The location is fantastic, just a short walk from the bustling Istiklal Street, which is full of great restaurants and has a vibrant ambiance. The apartment is also conveniently close to historical sites with easy access to public transport. We decided to walk from Okan's place to the Topkapi Palace, passing by the old bazaar, and it turned out to be a lovely day.
The apartment itself was very clean and exactly as described. The view from the window is breathtaking! The only minor issue we encountered was the bed mattress, which was a bit hard, and the bed was a little noisy. However, the sofa bed was quite comfortable and served as a great alternative.
Overall, I highly recommend Okan's place and will definitely stay here again on my next visit to Istanbul.

My stay at this Airbnb in the heart of Istanbul was absolutely fantastic. The location couldn't have been more perfect, offering easy access to all the vibrant attractions that this incredible city has to offer.
Firstly, Orhan's communication and hospitality were exceptional. From the moment I booked until the end of my stay, they were always available to answer any questions and ensure that everything was in order.
The apartment itself was cozy and comfortable, providing a welcoming retreat after a day of exploring. The decor was stylish and reflected the charm of Istanbul, creating a truly authentic experience. The amenities provided were top-notch, from the well-equipped kitchen to the comfortable bed.
What truly sets this Airbnb apart is its unbeatable location!

description: Monnas’ Rooms was founded with the dream of being a guest in your unique stories to be created in matchless places. We wanted to narrete our rooms by taking inspiration from women who shaped the history with their existences, thus creating living spaces to make your visit even more memorable for our guests. Because we are well aware of how much our experience would be enriched, when we all have a room of our own.

reviews.text:
I really enjoyed my stay here. The apartment was clean, comfortable and exactly as described. The mattress was very comfortable, and the Wi-Fi worked perfectly.
There are lots of cafes and shops nearby, so everything you need is within easy reach.
The host was very friendly and responsive. He helped with any questions I had and really made an effort to make my stay as easy and comfortable as possible.

Highly recommend this gem of a place. 8/10 min walk from Taksim Square. Very well appointed with all amenities. 2 bedrooms, large bathroom, and AC is all areas (blessing in this hot summer). Very friendly and helpful receptionists.
The Cihangir and Beyoğlu area is chock full of eateries and wind-down places; very picturesque.
Cihangir is on a hill, so the nearest stop for tram T1 is a climb down good number of stairs. This can be tiring on way back after a long day. One tip is to take T1 tram to last stop Kabatas, and then funicular F1 to Taksim square. The walk from there is easier. The Istanbul transport card is refillable and easy to use.

Our stay was absolutely amazing! The apartment was extremely comfortable, spotlessly clean, and in a fantastic location—very close to the tram, bus stops, and Taksim Square. The staff were super helpful and friendly throughout our stay.
The only tiny note is that the refrigerator is a bit small for a family, but other than that, everything was perfect. Highly recommended!

We had a wonderful stay at Monna’s Rooms in Istanbul! The place was spotless, tidy, and very comfortable. The location is fantastic—just an easy 8-minute walk to Taksim Square, which made it super convenient for exploring the city. The owner was extremely kind and even allowed us a late check-out as we were running behind schedule, which we really appreciated. Overall, everything was perfect. Highly recommended 100%!

The flat was very clean, nice interior design. There are everything you may need inside. Location is nice in the heart of Cihangir, close to Taksim & Galata tower. Staff is friendly. It was a nice experience for us.

description: We are Mayer Property Management with over 100 apartments in our portfolio. This apartment is located in Galata, the most historic and tourist neighborhood of Istanbul, just 50 meters from Istiklal Street and Şişhane subway station, and 100 meters from Galata Tower. The apartment features a queen bed, a fold-up bed for a 3rd guest, ultra-fast Wi-Fi, ELEVATOR, and all basic cleaning and cooking essentials. Self-check-in is available via password.

reviews.text: Location was fantastic - just 2 min off Istiklal Street and Sishane Metro (Istiklal Exit) and 3 min to the funicular. Some improvements the host can consider are to 1) makeover the building entrance as it looks uninviting like a storeroom and smells danky and musty which is not a good first impression. 2) the apartment is generally clean but the mould around the shower area and rotting wooden paneling of the bathroom needs to be fixed. Bed is comfortable with the most amazing bedsheets and quilt and the size of the whole apartment is great for lots of luggages (needs a few trips in the tiny lift and there are a few narrow steps to get into the building). Overall recommended as the host is also very responsive and everything was as per expectations.

We stayed in this apartment for two weeks. The location of this apartment complex is excellent—it’s just a 2-minute walk to the metro, 7-10 minutes to the T1 tram, 3 minutes to the funicular, and 5 minutes to Galata Tower. The area is full of great restaurants, cafes, coffee shops, and bars.
The apartment itself had everything we needed. It’s a good size, and I especially liked the divider that separates the bedroom area from the rest of the space.
The apartment was well-prepared, clean, and had all the necessary essentials. The complex is on a quiet street, and our neighbors didn’t bother us at all.
A few things that could be improved:
There is some mold in the shower cabin, and the bed linens are quite worn and pilled.
The host was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay!

As described. Very good communication. Great location within walking distance to many bars, cafes, and restaurants. Having an elevator is a huge plus. Will definitely check availability on future trips .

The apartment looked slightly different from the photos. There was no bedside lighting and painting, and the kitchen cabinets were a completely different color. It was a little less cozy in reality. The table lamp is broken and flickering.
The first night we slept with a broken window that wouldn't close, making it cold. On the second day, the boiler seemed to stop working, and the water was cold, but the owner fixed it.
The apartment's advantages include a very comfortable mattress, and the owner responded quickly and resolved any issues. It was also nice to be able to leave luggage at their office, a five-minute walk from the apartment.

We stayed for a week on holiday. The place is very nice, located in my favorite part of Istanbul - Galata. It is in the city center, but it is not noisy. The apartment is suitable for 2 people; it has good furniture and Wi-Fi. The only con is that it is dark, with small windows that all face the opposite building, and we did not feel comfortable opening them. In all other aspects, the apartment is perfect. The host is very responsive and also helped us with the transfer.

description: A charming and compact apartment in a peaceful corner of Kadıköy, the gem of Istanbul’s Asian side. Just a short walk to ferries, the subway, and metrobus, offering quick access to the city's main attractions. Equipped with everything you need, it’s steps from the vibrant cafes and shops of historic Yeldeğirmeni. Your perfect home away from home as you explore this breathtaking city. Hop on and start your adventure!

reviews.text:
This place is very nice. Everything was as described and the kitchen is very well equipped. The bathroom could maybe use an upgrade, but it was clean and perfectly working.
The hosts are very nice, very responsive and the check-in was easy. Definitely a recommendation!

We had a very pleasant stay. The apartment is in a very convenient location, with easy access to everything, and the neighborhood is pleasant and nice to walk around. Check-in was simple and hassle-free thanks to the clear instructions and contactless process. The hosts were always responsive and quick to reply.
The apartment is well-equipped with all the necessary kitchen essentials, making it easy to cook
Otherwise, the apartment is quiet, and the stay was smooth and comfortable

The good: the host is very responsive, pleasant and proactive. The apartment was spacious and well-located. Mostly modern and well-decorated.
The bad: unfortunately the bathroom is just not up to standard in my opinion. We had half a day without hot water due to an issue with the boiler and something in the bathroom was leaking - possibly the shower? There was also no real ventilation. The bed is also quite uncomfortable and the only fan is very loud (AC is only in the living room).
I think this apartment could be great if the bathroom were modernised and a better fan were on offer. The host was very responsive and sought to fix all issues quickly so I would consider a stay with Hanemo again.

Great place — exactly as shown in the photos. Well-maintained, clean, and comfortable. Easy to reach by public transportation, which made getting around very convenient. The hosts were responsive and helpful throughout the stay.

Demir’s place is an absolutely amazing location. Many food spots and close transportation to everything. Demir was extremely responsive when there was unavoidable local water issues he responded within minutes (Istanbul despite where you stay will experience this more often than not). The washer, AC & WIFI were great amenities. We had a 3 week stay and the only feedback I have before booking again would be mindful if you care for an orthopaedic mattress or anything higher quality the mattress/bedframe is average at best.

description: Renovated cozy flat in the heart of istanbul, 10 minute walk from taksim square.

reviews.text: clean room, amazing responsive helpful host, location is very close to the bus station and many attraction sites. very walkable area. the neighborhood around is a bit old and probably too quiet at night but overall great value for money and a smooth experience.

Close to the VFS Visa Center and Taksim square with one of the main tourist streets in the city. 7 min by taxi or 20 min by foot from Bus Station. But the neighborhood is ruined and dirty. I was a bit scared. The apartment is smaller than I expected. It's almost impossible to cook. Located on the 3rd floor with a very narrow spiral staircase. If you have a lot of luggage, it could be dangerous.

Thank you Hamed for being such an amazing host, my father had an amazing time. The location is amazing!!! In the heart of Taksim Square, close to restaurants and mosques! Hamed was so friendly and made sure my father had a smooth check in, came on site and helped. Also offered us an amazing deal that was too good to give up. Book here, You won't be disappointed!

Perfect place to stay in Istanbul. It's right in the heart of the city. The host and the staff are all very kind and welcoming, they helped me with anything I needed.
The place was very neat and clean and also super cozy. I could also do my laundry which was a very helpful option.
I highly recommend and would definitely go back again.

Parmida est une hôte très réactif et très serviable. Le logement se situe à 2 minute d’une grande rue avec plein de restaurant locaux à petit prix qui mène ensuite directement à l’avenue Taksim. Le logement se situe au troisième étage sans ascenseur donc attention au personne âgées, le logement est spacieux et ressemble au photo, il y a quelque défaut dans la cuisine ou la salle de bain mais bon pour le prix et l’emplacement le logement fait l’affaire, on se sent comme chez sois.

description: A great apartment in a brand new building. Our two-room apartment has a double bed and two single beds, and it is possible to accommodate up to 6 people with two sofa beds in the living room. There is a separate kitchen in the apartment. It is 11 minutes on foot to the Çırçır metro station and 15 minutes by car to Taksim, Levent and Şişli. There is a 24-hour reception at the entrance.

reviews.text: Great location! Easy and accessible to most touristic areas. Very quiet and safe neighbourhood. Markets are walking distance. The host himself was very helpful throughout our stay.

It’s my first time booking thought airbnb .it’s great experience and good price . The host was great and friendly . The view of the apartment was fantastic . All facilities of the apartment was good .

Das Hotel ist ein Neubau und sehr sauber , zudem mit allem ausgestattet, was man auch Zuhause in der Wohnung hat (Küche mit Elektrogeräten, Spülmaschine, Klimaanlage etc.). Es ist ein Mix aus Hotelzimmern und privaten Wohnungen. Daher alles geordnet, leise und sauber. Der Check-in ging schnell. Die Mitarbeiter sind freundschaftlich und helfen immer gerne weiter. Neue Bettwäsche etc. kann man immer problemlos bekommen. Sehr höflich gegenüber Gästen. Zu Fuß leider kaum erreichbar, da auf einem sehr steilen und hohen Hügel gelegen. Mit dem Auto aber optimal, da eine kostenlose Tiefgarage vorhanden ist. Wir kommen gerne wieder
Ev gayet güzeldi çok rahat ettik.İlgi alakada çok iyiydi.Ev fotoğraflarda görüldüğü gibi.
Ertan is a very nice host, and very helpful, I highly recommande this place, thanks.

description: Villa Galley is an 10 room facility. This room is for 2 people and is the smallest room of our facility. Our room sizes vary and we can accomodate up to 4 persons in a room. Please check availability of the other rooms if the one you are looking for is unavailable/booked. The rooms are identical in terms of equipment.

reviews.text: Very nice and clean room, exactly as described. Had an awesome and comfortable time there and would go back again. Hosts were very helpful in recommending places to eat and go shopping. Only downside is that it was a bit far from the metro. Other than that recommended highly.

A clean and tidy place. The ensuite was a bit small with the showerhead inside the toilet cubicle as a wetroom, but good water pressure and good enough for the price. The taxi from the airport didn't put his meter on (accidentally or not?) but charged us 80-100TL, the shuttle we arranged late at night with Can was 125TL just fyi. We didn't interact much with Can as we arrived early and left late but Timur was helpful even with the language barrier, ordered taxis for us and even yelled at one for making us late. The place seems to be in the middle of a residential zone but the Little Hagia Sophia was pretty close by and Sultanmet Square a bit of an uphill walk from there. The free wifi was a great bonus for when we had some downtime. All and all pretty happy.

The hotel is in a good location for sight-seeing and the room is clean and overall a good value, but quite small and the bathroom is a bit cramped. The receptionist who met us was very friendly and helpful but did not speak English.

My family and I stayed at Can's place for 4 nights and had a really great time! To start with the place is spotless, it's brand new and beautifully decorated. The room was spacey for all 3 of us; bathroom, shared kitchen, amenities were all at top level. The only issue we encountered was finding the place upon our arrival, which was rather late at night, but that was mainly due to our disorientation and maybe the limited light in the surrounding streets. Other than that, we were warmly welcomed by the staff and had a smooth check in.
The place is walking distance to Sultanahmet, where numerous attractions are located; approximately 15' away I would say. You can find many places to eat in the nearby area, as well as a great bakery, post office, etc.
All in all, I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul and I would like to thank everyone at the hotel for being so kind, caring and professional.

The hotel were as the host said, clean, with good atittude to help, the host (Serbay) was a great help for the things that we need, the hotel is near a good restaurants, and the principal places to visit. Recomended.

description:
Marmaray: After getting off at Yenikapı station, you can reach our property in just a few minutes' walk.
• Metro: Take the M1 (Airport-Kirazlı) or M2 (Hacıosman) line and get off at Yenikapı station.
• Tram: You can get off at the Aksaray stop on the T1 (Bağcılar-Kabataş) line and reach our street after a short walk.
• IETT: All bus routes from all over the city that pass through Aksaray stops are suitable for transportation.

reviews.text:
It was a compact space, good for one person, clean and smelling good with a private washroom and a basic kitchen. What I liked is the host was responsive and helped getting things arranged whatever is needed. Initially the AC was not cooling well but he fixed that when I reached out and overall it was a comfortable stay..
Washroom was a little small for someone pretty tall like me. The location is very good and the care taker as well was very polite, attentive and courteous, the only things I struggled was on and off wifi, i had to purchase a Turkish sim in order to do my work. I would like to stay here again if that is fixed.. Moreover it's a good, comfortable nice place to stay.

It's NOT really a good accommodation. The staff is helpful and polite, the apartment was clean and the location is good close to Marmaray train, tram and buses (2 km walking to Blue Mosque). The apartment is tiny (they have many apartments to rent and they put pictures of 3 or 4 of them, so you don't know which apartment will be designated for you). Many appliances don't work at all (TV didn't work, the stove was too slow, there was water everywhere in the bathroom). There is a little window not enough for a good renovation of the air. Overall NOT a good accommodation.

The place is worth the money you pay for it. It was quite small but clean and had good access to public transport (within walking distance). The host was very responsive and replied quickly to requests.

This is my first AirBnb experience and I was not disappointed. Was a very pleasant stay, the host extremely kind and helpful let me check in quite late. My only major gripe was that the tiles in the shower area could do some cleaning. I can definitely recommend this place and I can imagine staying here again if I were to visit Istanbul!

Yanlış hatırlamıyorsam 5 kez konakladım. Güvenilir. Her seferinde iletişim konusunda oldukça yardımseverdi. Televizyon konusunda ufak bir aksaklık oldu ve hemen düzeltmek için biri geldi. Giriş çıkışlarda bir problem yaşamadık, konumu gayet basit metroya, taksi duraklarına, ve yemek yerlerine, caddeye yakın. Sunduğu olanakların hepsi mevcuttu. Sadece fotoğraftakinden daha küçük bir oda. Ama 2 kişinin konaklaması için gayet yeterli. Sürekli tercih ettiğim bir yer, ev sahibine teşekkürler. :)

description:
Experience the unique Bosphorus view in Moda, the heart of Istanbul. Stay with your loved ones in our centrally located house with its modern architecture and stylish design. Our house promises its guests a pleasant time with its proximity to entertainment centers, culinary and historical spots and all transportation lines.

In addition to all the amenities that should be available in a house, we also have cleaning staff at your service whenever you wish.

reviews.text:
Amazing apartment, I really enjoyed my stay! It’s the first time the apartments looks better in real life than on photos!
The location is perfect, the view from the window is just amazing. The check in was very easy, smart lock is very convenient.
Bed in master bedroom is top notch!
I am giving 5 stars to this place with no doubts, although I would love If host paid a little bit more attention to some details: 1) Overall, apartment is very clean, although floor was a little bit sticky in some places, there is some mold near the kitchen window (not a lot but still); 2) The apartment is gorgeous, you can see it has expensive furniture and overall it feels elite, but in little details it lacks maintenance and finesse (baseboards are coming off in few places; lights in both bathrooms are very dimmed and it’s basically impossible to shave); 3) for such price, having something basic like shower gels/shampoos in bath salt/sugar in the kitchen would be really nice
I recommend it anyway!

The house is beautiful, like from Pinterest. Check-in was the most convenient we've had this year. Inside, everything is very clean. The location of the house is perfect - right in the center of Moda, but quiet. The kitchen is convenient. There are absolutely no supplies provided: soap, shampoo, salt, laundry detergent, slippers (the floors are cold), tea, sponge etc. There are only towels, toilet paper and that's it. There are no thresholds anywhere in the house or outside. In the first shower, the water doesn't drain, it leaked into the room. In the second shower, the glass door that closes the shower is off its hinges and standing inside. Water leaks onto the floor of the bathroom and bedroom. The internet is so slow that it barely suffices to open the messengers. Speedtest currently shows 265-500 kbps. host responds 4-6 hours after the question is asked. And one of the rooms has no upper light. But it’s really good looking house.

When we first entered the apartment it looked just like the photos and the view was really great. However we soon noticed a strong smell of cigarettes (there was even a packet of cigarettes on one of the shelves in the kitchen)- the smell was really overwhelming and suffocating. We even felt that our clothes began to smell of cigarettes after three days in the apartment. We also noticed that the glass shower door was broken and resting precariously against the wall.
Also, on the first evening the apartment above from the same air bnb hosts was having a party. We tried to ask them to be quiet but they refused to open the door and just continued shouting and turned up the music. We contacted the host and they said they would speak with them. Unfortunately it didn't do much to stop the noise and we had a very sleepless night the first night. Overall we felt that the hosts were not very sympathetic and didnt offer any kind of solution for the cigarette smoke or the partying neighbours.

Staff was very friendly and super helpful. Apartment it is spacious and comfortable, exactly like in the photos. The bathroom lighting it is an issue though - very dark and you can't see much inside. Location is good but the street feels unsafe at night. Note: the building has an unusual entrance. You need to pass by an automatic rolling door first and then the main door. It feels like entering a commercial warehouse everytime.

First of all, we were pleased with the location being close to everywhere but in a quiet area. Since it was not a very busy street, we had no problems loading and unloading. The apartment was very clean and comfortable. Communication with the landlord was easy.

description:
Our flat is a spacious and elegant 1 bedroom, 1 living room (w/open plan kitchen and a large desk), 1 bathroom (no bathtub, walk-in shower only) flat of 55 square meters that sleeps 2 on a queen size platform bed and can sleep a 3rd guest via an additional bed in the living room (crib is also available upon request).

The flat is located on the 3rd floor and has a private balcony with a Galata Tower view.

reviews.text:
If you are going to Istanbul check this place for availability!
Great location, hospitality manner by Emrah, great location, comfortable bed, good wi-fi connection, balcony -everything was great!
Easy check in& check out. Emrah was very kind and we had our best vacation. The kitchen is fully equipped and you can basically have all comfort you need.
The location is so close to Galata tower & the area is very communicative with shops, coffee shops, restaurants. We had a walk to Taksim & Spice bazaar and both of the locations were 20 mins by walking.
Close metro station, however you don't really need it as you are pretty much in the city center and you can walk and explore.
You will not regret if you book this place, especially for this price.

Good location, everything is nearby. It is quiet at night, so you can sleep well. The place matches the photos and is clean. The only downside is the communication with the host. When I needed help with the transport card, my messages were not answered

Our host was extremely considerate and helpful. The apartment was nicer than the photos and well equipped. Our host left bottled water, coffee and even laundry detergent. The balcony had a stunning view of the Galeta Tower. The interesting street was filled with shops and restaurants and was very quiet at night. Very workable kitchen and an extremely comfortable bed. Bedroom faced a back courtyard which made for very quiet sleeps. Good hot water, excellent wifi and so handy to have a washing machine and drying rack.
We would highly recommend this Airbnb.

If there was an Oscar for hosts, Emrah could have won the main nomination. It is extremely pleasant to communicate with him – starting with tips about restaurants and household issues to a simple friendly conversation. We contacted Emrah many times and he was always helpful, even bringing us coffee at 11pm one night! Up to this point, I have not had a more successful, friendly and productive interaction with the host.
The apartment itself is very comfortable. Nice balcony overlooking Galata, equipped kitchen and bath. Without exaggeration, we felt like we were at home. Very high quality housekeeping is regularly held in the apartment.
The location couldn't be better - the apartment is located on one of the most beautiful streets of Istanbul. Near Istiklal street, metro, trams, restaurants and shops. Convenient to get to any place in the city.
Will definitely stay here again.

Emrah was a thoughtful, responsive host. His apartment was quite comfortable and in a great location in the new district — close to Galata Tower and Istikal Avenue but on a quiet nearby street. (BTW, I recommend staying in the new district instead of the old part of town unless your visit is very short.) One thing to note about the apartment is that it is located most of the way up a steep hill so be prepared for some uphill walking, or you could take a cab if climbing presents a problem. Also, reaching the apartment requires walking up three flights of stairs. Overall a very nice stay.

description:
For your trips with your family or friends upto 6 people, beautiful modern apartment completely renovated at the city center, close to bus stop, metro, major roads, shops, cafes, restaurants.
This consists of: an entrance hall designed as a fully equipped kitchen, a living room,2 bedrooms with double beds, 1 bedroom with 2 single beds,2 bathroom with walk-in shower, washer, tv.

reviews.text:
Cozy apartment near the metro station within walking distance from ships and restaurants.
Quiet and warm with no noise from the streets and the air conditioning works well... Strong internet and cozy furniture... There is a balcony off the main bedroom and an elevator in the building.
The beds are very uncomfortable and all you feel is Springs on each part of your body. Should be replaced or at least a mattress topper added... The pillows are not the best and the shower leaks all over the bathroom floor. The dining room is spacious and cozy and the smart TV is awesome.
The kitchen is very tiny and there is no space to properly cook your meals, there needs to be additional table to make is more feasible... The kitchen needs more items for guests to use to cook with as there are a lot of things missing.
The host replys but sometimes it takes a while. Very helpful and friendly and they meet you at the apartment with the keys.
Be sure to ask for extra keys and to have balcony unlocked

Dusty and not clean apartment. Beds were broken and very uncomfortable, springs from the mattress were broken and hurting our backs. There was a bad smell in the apartment. There was no batteries for the AC remote control (there was only 1 remote control for the whole apartment). We kept changing the batteries from the TV remote control and the AC Remote control.
Great host and location as well

The place is very wonderful as a location. All services are available around you. Getting in and out is very easy. Housing is very warm in winter. Mr. Amir, The employee, is a very cooperative, respected. The only annoying thing is the windows isolation needs to be fixed. But yes, I recommend the place again and I'll definitely be back.
Perfect place , perfect Location

description:
A house with a garden all to yourself in the most beautiful location of Tarabya, where you can enjoy the view of the Bosphorus and the bridge.
A wonderful villa with a garden where you can enjoy the magnificent view of the Bosphorus, surrounded by nature, where you will only hear the sounds of birds, in a thousand colors of green. (You have a barbecue facility) (There is a seating group and a dining table set in the garden)

reviews.text:
Fantastic location — even better than expected and the view is better than in the pictures. The rooms were spacious, the living room was comfortable, and the kitchen equipment was clean and well organized. The host was exceptional: extremely responsive, patient, and genuinely helpful throughout our stay. We especially appreciated the extra effort made to accommodate our requests.
Overall we had a very good stay. The only points worth mentioning are that some parts of the furniture and interior feel a bit outdated, and the bathroom ventilation could definitely be improved. For the price range, we felt that some upgrades and maintenance would improve the experience even further.
That said, we still enjoyed our stay and would consider returning again, especially if some updates are made or if the pricing better reflects the current condition of the property.

This is my worst airbnb experience. The house is 450 $ CAN per night and it not worth 100$.
The first floor washroom is worn out and dirty, and it smells like mold. The toilet seat is tiny and doesnt cover the tiolet bowl, disgusting and disrespectful. The kitchen doesn't have dishwasher like its supposed to . The kitchen looks old and dirty, same as the washroom.
The stairs for the 2nd floor are very unsafe. I hit head in the ceiling because it's very low.
There is NO dryer in the laundry room . On the way to the laundry room , the floor is higher and easy to hurt my feet going into the washroom.
Mattress in the bedroom is very old and the bed frame is broken, making a sink hole.
Some man was visiting the house everyday at 8 :00. I didn't like that , no privacy.
As we were leaving, saw a scorpion on the 1st floor( to no surprise to be honest).
None of the blinds were working. The curtains provided were long enough to cover half the window.
This place is a rip-off scam.

Breathtaking views of the water, Yeşim’s place was exactly like in the pictures . It has a large living room, a comfortable family room with a TV, spacious kitchen , 3 large bedrooms plus one small one. It has a powder room downstairs and a bathroom upstairs with a shower . The patio is amazing for breakfast, dinner and also night time views of the Bosphorus. Definitely plan to come back again!

This is a great villa in the heart of Tarabya in Sariyer. We spent about a week in July in this beautiful place for family reunion. The house is located on top of the hill with great view to the Bosphorus and the famous Yavuz Sultan Selim Bridge. The garden is very pleasant we spent lots of time eating outside and enjoying the view, fresh air and nice breeze even in the hot days.
The neighbourhood is quite and not tourists, while great - local meat and fish - restaurants are 10-15 min away walking (5 min bu Uber) including nice marina and surrounding area along the Bosphorus. Local shops and (super)markets for daily fresh groceries are within 5 min walk away and all touristic and shopping area are 20-30 min away by car.
Yesim and Sertac are great host, very kind, responsive and helpful anytime we needed help and/or had any question. They know the area and the locals very well and gave us all nice tips and recommendations.
We will surely come back again to this beautiful place

Beautiful water views even better than the photos. The house was clean and comfortable Nice neighbourhood not far from the water and a short trip to the ferry terminal. The ferry trip to Istanbul centre was a great way to see the city. Highly recommend stay.

description:
We provide a special room and comfort zone. You would find yourself in history of istanbul.
Just 3 minutes walking distance from Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque & Topkapı Palace and all other precious places.

reviews.text:
Great place in a great location. The room was clean and serviced each day. The bathroom was also clean. We had no issues with air conditioning or the water which both ran perfectly while we were there. The location is a 5 min walk from Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque, close to a tram stop which means easy access to everything. The host is very responsive and booked us a hassle free transfer to and from the airport.
Overall had a wonderful time.
Extremely central location, just a 3-minute walk from Aya Sophia! The staff is very nice and helpful! The room is clean and comfortable!

Great location and communication. The room was simple yet very clean and comfortable. Staff were also lovely and accommodating.
Only downside was the soundproofing (or lack thereof). Music from the street below and noise from the adjacent room made it difficult to sleep most nights.
A very accessible location from all points of view, exactly as in the photos. 10/10

Öncelikle, yazılanlara 2 gün geçmesine rağmen hiçbir şekilde cevap alamadım; bu konuda oldukça özensiz davrandıklarını düşünüyorum.
Bunun dışında, bulunduğu konum oldukça güzel. Etrafı yürüyüş yapmak ve gezmek için elverişli. Odalar temizdi ve fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibiydi; bu açıdan herhangi bir sorun yaşamadım.
Ancak odalar arası ses yalıtımı oldukça zayıf, bu da rahatsız edici bir durumdu.

reviews.text: Excellent host, Mehmet is great over text and helped me at 2am when I couldn't work the code (double click the star and input the code). I want to especially thank Mehmets brother who is the kindest ever and helpful. The location is great and the tram at the bottom of the main road. Bags were kindly stowed on our last day too. I had an issue with the shower not draining and then flooding after. Selim offered to send a serviceman. There is a balcony terrace which is beautiful if used but I didn't. The TV is good, can cast to it and with netflix and other apps. It's on the third floor with at times narrowish stairs so be aware. There is great ironing, cleaning and drying facilities which is a huge bonus with brand new Bosch machines and a iron. New dressing gowns and slippers provided and a huge array of towels. Honestly you'll save money so book here and get a similar or better experience than some hotels! thankyou Selim and thankyou to your brother. Best wishes!!!! Turkiyë with love

Decent place. The area is very quiet which was lovely. The place looks exactly like the pictures. Great location, close to shops, restaurants, train. The bed was extremely comfortable which was the highlight of the place for us.
Could be cleaned better, it was generally clean but there was dust on some places e.g. light fixture and a used toothpick on the floor. The water did not get all the way hot but it was decent enough. The entrance and stairway smells of cigarette which is not very welcoming. But the room smelled fine.

Place was great and made us feel at home. We liked how the host had taken care of all the basic amenities in the house. Bed was super comfortable and the house had everything.
The room came with a beautiful terrace where u could just sit and chill.
The host was really helpful. The house has a bit of stairs and he helped us with our suitcases and with every little detail we asked him for. Overall a really nice stay.
Tram station is at walking distance.

Really enjoyed our time. We stayed for a week to work and it was tight quarters, but exactly what was described and all we needed. Mehmet was super responsive and even replied when we arrived at 1am. He also gave a provided a couple of good restaurant recommendations. Location was perfect - far enough from the action that it’s quiet, but close enough that you’re not too far from shops/restaurants.

Despite almost no reviews we decided to stay with Mehmet and it was absolutely the best decision. Quiet, new mattresses and sheets, comfy towels, clean, central and great neighborhood. Amazing water power in the shower. Will come back when in Cihangir!

description:
1) If you want, I can pick you up from Sabiha Gokcen Airport (🚖20€ for a fee)
2) The whole apartment is not for full rent. You will be staying in a room in the house. I'm staying in this house too 🏡
