reviews.text: First of all, Burak himself is very supportive, helpful, and easily accessible. Even though I didn’t have internet access before getting the apartment, his guidance made it easy to find the place. The apartment is conveniently located near Sabiha Airport, taking only 20 minutes to reach. Additionally, the apartment is completely worth its cost.

The host didn’t talk much, but he was decent and reliable. It was raining on the day I arrived, and the host kindly picked me up from the bus station. Much appreciated.
The room is spacious and the bed is comfy . There’s hot shower and a well-equipped kitchen. Very close to SAW airport. About a 10-minute walk to the metro and 15 minutes to the airport by metro.
Highly recommended!
Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in very easy. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend it.

The room is very spacious, perfect for one person, and the bed is comfortable. The house is clean and well maintained, with two toilets and a clean bathroom, which is very convenient.
The owner is a very nice and respectful person—quiet, but kind and helpful. The location is also good: you can walk to the sea in about 15–20 minutes if you like.
Overall, it’s a very good place to stay, and I would recommend this room to others.

A staying with mixed feeling. From one side Burak has been attentive and responsive, he offered food tea and coffee and checked out via messages that I was doing ok throughout my stay. The location of the house is startegic to get to S.G. Airport easily by metro. However, I was invited to stay in a room that was not the one I booked, much less nice and with a strong smell of mould. No bed linen were provided but a ripen and stained duvet cover with a piece of pile fabric on the mattress. I brought up the issue with Burak but it felt on deaf ears making me feel somewhat weird about what was going on, and why I could not stay in the room i booked - which served also as living room for the flat.

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text: responsive host with clear guidance given, although had a short 1 night stay but it is comfortable. location with about 10min drive near the airport, if you're catching a flight next day this maybe a good option.

Great stay at Tolga's place in Istanbul! Super convenient location, close to everything. The apartment was clean, comfy, and had everything I needed. Tolga was an awesome host, really friendly and full of helpful tips about the city. Definitely recommend!

Head’s up that Tolga’s place would suit those who wanna be closer to the Sabiha Gökçen Airport, and particularly those who want a responsive host that proactively guides you to the location. Of course, with the draw of that area of Pendik being its proximity to the airport, there isn’t much else for those who wanna sightsee or shop. Also, the visitor should note that the setup of the apartment is particularly male oriented, although I’m sure Mr Tolga, with his cleanliness and eagerness to help, will assist anyone alike.

Tolga is a great person. His house is located in a nice neighbourhood with no noise at all. The room has a green space around it, and neighbours are very quiet. Also, the house is super clean, including the bathroom. We could ask for extra blankets, and Tolga had no problem with us arriving late from the airport. Thanks Tolga.

We have been amazingly happy with this accommodation. It offers a very good value for money accommodation. Clean spaces and he has been available and helpful to arrive at the apartment. But most of all he has been very kind upon our arrival, offering more than we needed, amazing person and perfect experience.

description: You will enjoy staying in our modern designed house on the Main Street.With the location of our house, you can meet all your needs such as shopping, transportation and restaurants within walking distance. Our house is built in 2023 and is completely brand new. There are 2 rooms, air conditioning in the living room. Our furniture and bedspreads are all brand new. If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everywhere as a family. Cafe in the building offers you 10% discount.

reviews.text:
Comfortable and spacious place, exactly as described and shown in the photos. Very accessible location, specially if you're driving. The host, mrs Ece is very responsive and helpful.
All in all, great experience, I would recommend it.

Here’s a natural review in English:
We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Istanbul with our family. The location was excellent, with plenty of good restaurants, cafés, and supermarkets within walking distance, making everything very convenient.
The apartment was comfortable, clean, and well-suited for a family stay. The host was extremely kind, helpful, and always responded to our messages immediately, which made our experience even better.
We felt very welcome throughout our stay and would definitely recommend this apartment to families looking for a comfortable place in a great location in Istanbul. We would be happy to stay here again in the future.

Ece is very friendly and responds quickly. All staff at Mado are also helpful and friendly. Only problems were that the shower didn’t drain and was in danger of overflowing so you couldn’t shower long. I communicated this to Ece, so hopefully it will not be a problem for future guests. The bedding on the bed in the main bedroom was also not the most comfortable. Everything else was great about the place. Looks like the pictures!

First of all I cannot think of a single thing that didn't break during our stay, the couch legs couldn't support the weight of a single adult and broke we called the host or rather the caretaker the host was nowhere to be seen and he came over to "fix" it he replaced the fragile legs with more fragile plastic legs that broke again shortly after so we just gave up, the shower head also broke because of the water pressure (must have been cheap quality) this time we didn't bother calling the "host" and bought one from our own pocket and fixed it ourselves, you cannot use the back entrance or the stairs which is something they didn't mention in their rules, you have to go through the Cafe every single time and feel everyone there stare and judge you, the Cafe closes at midnight but you cannot be out past 10pm yet the apartment is very far from anything good so if you want to be back in time you have to go back super early which is also something they forgot to mention in their rules.

The location is on a main street with four lanes. Sleeping would be possible if the windows could be closed. Heating is provided by the ceiling-mounted AC, but when it is on, cigarette smoke from the restaurant downstairs seeps in.
We left the apartment after just one night, despite having booked a stay of over ten days. The host refused to refund any of the remaining days. Highly not recommended.

description:
Our place, a new renovated building, is centrally located in Beyoğlu which is the historical area of İstanbul.
The place is 10 mins walk away to İstiklal Street, Metro Station, Traditional restaurants and night clubs. Also; It is so close to to most important historical places such as Taksim Square, Eminönü, Blue Mosque and Galata Tower.

reviews.text: The Airbnb is conveniently located near Taksim Square in Istanbul. Emre helped me carry my luggage up the stairs. The bed was comfortable and the wifi worked well. The Airbnb is convenient for short stays. Thank you for being my host Emre!
Good apartment! Clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Great location, smooth check-in, and a very friendly host. I would definitely stay here again!

It was a great stay at Emre's. The host was very responsive and is very kind. He offered tea as well. The room was great..you have your own space. It is worth every penny. The facilities are mini kitchen and bathroom in your room. I would reccomend the cleanliness to be inproved more for the bathroom but overall the room was GREAT. It is very close to the city center. Walkable everywhere and great reataurants around. A three minutes to Istiklal street. I highly recommend Emre's place.

very nice place , 17 min walk to Taksim. 8 min walk to istiklal.
grocery store nearby for water and snack.
a lot of restaurants cheap and good.
narrow spiral stairs, 45 of them to reach the apartment, apartment itself is small, but good for two people

Konum merkezi bir noktadaydı istiklal caddesine yakın evin hemen yanında bakkal da bulunuyor küçük ihtiyaçlarımızı ordan giderdik.Giriş çıkış saatlerinde esneklik sağlayıp yardımcı oldu.İletişimde hiç problem yaşamadık çok hızlı geri dönüş sağladı.Ev fotoğraftakilerin aynısıydı temiz ve düzenliydi.Yatak özellikle aşırı rahattı.Mutfakta da küçük ama ihtiyacımızı fazlasıyla karşıladı.Bu lokasyonda yeniden konaklayacak olursam kesinlikle yine burayı tercih edeceğim.

description:
Stay in a beautifully renovated 19th-century Ottoman-era apartment where historic character meets modern comfort. Featuring high ceilings, exposed brick walls, and original wooden floors, this unique home preserves the soul of historic Istanbul.

Located in the heart of Beyoğlu, just a 5-minute walk from İstiklal Street, you’ll be surrounded by cafés, restaurants, boutiques, and galleries.

With easy access to the metro, buses, and taxis, you can easily explore Istanbul’s famous attractions.

reviews.text:
A nice apartment, the living room is cozy and comfortable, a bit smaller than what appears in the photos though. Very functional bathroom. But the best thing about the apartment is the location! Excellent location not far from Taksim ( walking distance) and a bus station nearby. We didn't find the area noisy.
It is on the very first floor so you don't hassle much with the luggage, a market just below the apartment, and there is luggage storage nearby which is useful if your flight is in the evening.
The one con of the place is it was quite hot since we came in July ends with no AC, but there are 3 fans, one in each room which made it very manageable.
Rayan is a super host as well, great and quick communication with great English, and he brought us 2 big water bottles before we arrived which was a very nice gesture of him.

Everything in general was good and had a good price - quality relationship. The host was very friendly and helpful and the house was overall ok except some small details like the space that we expect the rooms a bit bigger. The house and bath was clean that was very positive. The location was comfortable also, near Istiklal road and near bus station. Overall we would recommend it as a choice to stay in Istanbul.

We had a wonderful stay at Rayan’s place. He was an excellent host—friendly, responsive, and always willing to help whenever we had any questions. The accommodation was exactly as described: clean, comfortable, and well-equipped, with everything we needed for a great stay. The location was also very convenient, making it easy to explore the area. We truly appreciated Rayan’s hospitality and would happily stay here again. Highly recommended!

"5 stars! I had an amazing stay at Ryan's place! The location was absolutely perfect for me, super close to the city center and all the main attractions. Ryan was extremely communicative and responsive, making my check-in process smooth.
The apartment itself was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The decor was tasteful and everything was well-maintained. I felt right at home!
Would definitely recommend Ryan's place to anyone looking for a great spot in the area. Would definitely stay again, thanks Ryan!"

A lovely apartment, clean, comfortable and with everything we needed for our stay. It is within walking distance of Istiklal street and Taksim square where there are shops, restaurants, bars and public transport links. Rayan is an excellent host -he responded quickly to all communications and offered helpful suggestions.

description:

Esatpasa, Fatin Rüştü Zorlu Cd 37 , 34704 Ataşehir Dream House is a small scale 5-star Boutique hotel, which was built in 2023, the design of each room has a different concept, our goal in this unit is to create a sense of love and relax. reviews.text: The place is truly amazing. Everything you need is accessible and reachable! Aylar is a good host and very friendly. Checkin was so easy as well as checkout. Definitely recommend the place, so peaceful, clean and comfortable.

Sure, here's the revised review for a hotel in Ataşehir, Istanbul:
---
I had a wonderful stay at the hotel in Ataşehir, Istanbul. The Host was very helpful, ensuring that we felt safe and well-cared for throughout our stay. The Host was exceptionally responsive and always ready to assist with any questions or needs we had. Additionally, the hotel's location was fantastic—close to everything we needed, making our stay incredibly convenient. Highly recommended!
---

I would truly recommend this stay to anyone looking to be in a quiet place, next to public transportation, restaurants, cafes, local mart, and within walking distance of the local mosque for prayer time. The bath was cool, bed very comfy to the degree that you can spend the whole day sleeping by accident, the aesthetics are very well as put together as the liveliness of the design. It would definitely be the place to stay again. The host was very helpful, kind and patient. Check in was simple.

Good place with lovely neighbors! A beautiful apartment with everything you want, especially the bathtub and TV. 2 supermarkets, several ATMs and a post office (PTT) and more within 10min walk. I would recommend ptt's ATM to withdraw Lira, since it doesn't charge extra fees. Our host Aylar always replies swiftly and gave us help promptly.
There is a bus station downstairs where you can find normal yellow buses. Some go to a ferry port. It takes 1.5h to popular tourist attractions. If you want a long and relaxing vacation, this is a place for you!
I do not recommend the blue minibuses, they can not be found reliably and it is difficult to communicate with the driver. You have to tell them where you want to get off. And you must buy tickets with cash on minibuses.

Except for the location, everything was fine with the rental. The apartment was as advertised. Everything worked etc. I had originally chosen the apartment based on the location as it was very near many places I regularly visited. The actual inaccurate location that was shown on Airbnb was about 1/2 hour walk from the shown location. I believe there is now a note about this discrepancy in the description and I hope the actual location will be sorted out with the Airbnb platform. This is the first time in many years I've actually had this issue.

description:

description:
Super bright and sunny place in Galata district. Brand new furnished apartment comes with 2 AC & 2 Bathroom & dedicated work space.

Two bedroom apartment in a very nice and quiet area close to famous Galata Tower, Istiklal Avenue, Karakoy, markets and public transport.

Located on the 3rd floor in a building which was recently completely renovated.

I'm happy to welcome you as a friend and will happy to show you our hospitality!

reviews.text: We thorougly enjoyed our stay. Exactly as described/shown in the listing and photographs. Sparklingly clean with plenty of space for our family of 4 with two teenage girls. There is an air conditioning unit in the hallway outside the two bedrooms and one in the living room. They served to cool the apartment relatively quickly, though the master bedroom remained warmer. We appreciated the extra rollaway bed in the living room & the washing machine. At one point, we needed to reset the WiFi, and Cordo responded promptly with simple instructions. The location is close to the port, to Galata Tower (less than 5 minutes), and to Taksim Square (~15 minutes). We even walked to the Grand Bazaar across the river - not super close but doable. It is located on the third floor with no elevator, and the street to get to the apartment is steep, but that is typical of the landscape. My only recommendation is to replace the bed linens. Sheets, pillow cases, and comforters were a little scratchy.

We rented this apartment as a group of friends for a few days while in Istanbul. It is such a cute space and exactly what we needed. It had a modern decor, it was a safe building, and the basic amenities needed for our stay. The living room had great afternoon light. There was a very nice rooftop terrace as well! This location was excellent. It was in the center, near the Galata Tower, and public transport. Ali was very responsive and kind! He made the process easy and was accommodating to our requests. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it for a group of friends who want to have a comfortable cute apartment in a central location. I would like to mention that to access the apartment there are only stairs available and no elevator.

We loved our stay at Cordo's beautiful apartment by Galata tower. Cordo and his team were always very responsive. The apartment is really nice and location is just amazing.
My only suggestion is for the folks who will be traveling with a car to Cordo's apartment. It is important to note that once you park in the given parking spot, it is not easy at all during the day to move in and out since you are in a downhill street that is extremely narrow while traffic is going in both directions. Also the there are other vehicles parked right next to the car so its literally impossible to move the car.
The parking instructions provided by Cordo should be improved since we had no idea about the metal rods that are on the road and locked that must be removed for you to park the car.
Another suggestion is regarding 2 AC units but none installed in any of the bedrooms. Summer months are very hot and our bedrooms did not cool much at all and we had to leave the bedroom doors open & no privacy.

This was one of the best airbnbs I have stayed at, it was seconds walk away from Galata tower which is the best spot for food shopping and sight seeing in Istanbul. The bedding was very comfortable and the apartment was very clean and spacious. The air con worked great and we felt right at home. Ali was very responsive and responded within minutes, the water is clean all amenities are provided.

We had an amazing stay at this apartment. It looked exactly like the photos — modern, clean, and very comfortable. The location was excellent and convenient for getting around the city. The host was very kind and always responded quickly whenever we had a question or needed help. Communication was smooth and everything was well organized.
We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to others.
